  • New sandbox.userPolicy.filesystem.enumeratePaths in settings.json for Windows enumerate-only directory grants.
  • New /index commands; managed shared tgrep indexing enabled by default for eligible repositories.
  • PDF attachments on Grok 4.7 / Grok 4.6 now fall back to file references.

3. Hot Issues

  1. #5400 [CLOSED] Regression in 1.0.108: deferred MCP function_call loses namespace — A deferred MCP tool call succeeds, then the next request fails with 400 Missing namespace for function_call. High impact for SDK-hosted sessions; closed same day, suggesting a fast fix.
  2. #5185 [OPEN] CRITICAL: copilot-runtime-bazel-cache memory usage vs limits (dotcom) — Internal statuspage alert on runtime infra; worth watching as an availability signal for the service backing CLI usage.
  3. #5392 [OPEN] Claude responses report doubled prompt on ~0.3% of calls — usage and billing — A metering/billing correctness bug with a precise repro rate; likely to get fast attention given cost implications.
  4. #5390 [OPEN] macOS sandbox: allowLocalNetwork: true still generates hostLoopback: deny — Breaks Gradle inside the sandbox (localhost daemon unreachable). Classic sandbox-vs-local-dev-tooling friction.
  5. #5388 [OPEN] Sandbox credential masking ineffective for GH_TOKEN/GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN on GHE data-residency tenants — Token env vars dropped before masking; enterprise security concern.
  6. #5402 [OPEN] MCP Entra silent sign-in uses /common, fails for single-tenant apps (AADSTS50194) — Regression since 1.0.107 forcing /mcp auth every session; enterprise auth pain.
  7. #5395 [OPEN] Session stops accepting messages after session.background_tasks_changed times out; background agent result lost — Session-host event delivery timeout (120s) strands sessions; serious reliability issue for background agents.
  8. #5394 [OPEN] cancelBackgroundCompaction() emits no compaction_complete — "Compacting conversation…" UI gets stuck after SDK-cancelled compaction; SDK/extension correctness.
  9. #5387 [OPEN] [Windows] PowerShell tool session hangs indefinitely when script spawns background process with Start-Process -RedirectStandardOutput — Windows tooling hang; blocks common server-start workflows.
  10. #5323 [OPEN] Feature: disable agent checkpoint refs (refs/agents/*) — Every agent turn creates commits under the user's git identity; pollutes ref-rendering tools. Community reaction modest (👍1) but the concern is structural.

Also notable: #5320 (CLOSED, 👍11) OSC 7501 agent-status reporting for Herdr — the most-upvoted item in this window.

4. Key PR Progress

No pull requests were updated in the last 24h (0 items). Progress this period is visible only through releases and issue closures.

5. Hot Discussions

No Discussions data was provided; this section is omitted.

6. Feature Request Trends

  • Permissions & sandbox configurability (epic #316): finer-grained filesystem grants (Windows enumerate paths in 1.0.108), localhost/loopback allowances (#5390), and disabling agent checkpoint refs (#5323).
  • MCP/enterprise auth: fixed OAuth callback ports for pre-registered clients (#5391), tenant-correct Entra sign-in (#5402), Kerberos/NTLM proxy support (#5142, closed), and Trusted Access for Cyber linkage (#4322).
  • Session/agent observability & control: native OS notifications for long tasks (#2616), OSC 7501 status reporting (#5320), remote voice mode via GitHub Mobile (#5315).
  • Platform parity: Git Bash on Windows (#508), shell expansion consistency ($HOME vs ~, #144, closed).
  • ACP/extension ecosystem: Copilot Connectors in --acp mode (#5397), hook ask decisions reaching ACP clients (#5396, closed).
  • Enterprise docs/trust: verified browser-extension publisher and security-review docs for the browser-use plugin (#5389).

7. Developer Pain Points

  • Sandbox vs. real dev workflows: loopback denial breaking Gradle (#5390) and ineffective credential masking on GHE tenants (#5388) show sandbox policy still surprises users.
  • Session reliability: multiple independent failure modes — shared-writer I/O failure in -p mode (#5357), background-task event timeout (#5395), un-resumable sessions (#5386), and stuck compaction UI (#5394).
  • Usage/billing trust: doubled prompt reporting on ~0.3% of Claude calls (#5392) and auto-compaction triggering on a single contradicted reading (#5393).
  • Windows rough edges: PowerShell hangs with Start-Process (#5387), generic Credential Manager diagnostics (#5399), Git Bash absence (#508).
  • Enterprise auth and proxy friction: per-session /mcp auth re-runs for single-tenant Entra apps (#5402) and corporate proxy auth gaps (#5142).
  • Agent hygiene in the repo: unwanted refs/agents/* checkpoint commits authored under the user's identity (#5323) and subagent prompt contradictions on temp-file usage (#5352).

Sources: github/copilot-cli releases and issues updated 2026-11-09 → 2026-11-10.

OpenCode — anomalyco/opencode

OpenCode Community Digest — 2026-11-09

1. Today's Highlights

No new releases shipped in the last 24 hours, but the issue tracker remains highly active with 50 issues and 50 PRs updated. The free-tier quota confusion continues to dominate community attention (Issue #59387 alone has 339 comments), while the v2 service architecture is surfacing a cluster of infrastructure bugs around port collisions, config reloads, and MCP process spawning. On the PR side, maintainer jlongster landed a three-part stacked series reworking the PTY protocol and shell command execution in the process daemon.

2. Releases

No new releases in the last 24 hours.

3. Hot Issues

  1. #59387 — Free tier issues mega-thread (339 comments, 👍27)
    The canonical clearinghouse for free-tier quota complaints ("Free usage exceeded", reset timers that never fire). The sheer volume signals a systemic billing/quota-state problem still unresolved after two weeks.

  2. #43250 — keep.tokens not honoured; compaction walk-back unbounded
    Reproduced compaction bug where agent sessions carry ~234K tokens against a 15K setting — 5–15× over budget. Directly impacts cost and context quality for long-running agent workflows.

  3. #50814 — Model emits tool calls as literal text after compaction
    Post-compaction, tool calls degrade into plain text and never dispatch, silently breaking sessions. A serious correctness failure in the compaction pipeline.

  4. #51570 — LM Studio model discovery fails with API keys (👍4)
    /models requests omit the configured API key, breaking local-model discovery even though inference works. High-impact for the local-LLM segment.

  5. #59861 — Restore catalog-price estimates when providers report $0
    Since v2.2.0, Go subscription sessions show no cost, and the "$X spent" indicator disappeared. Community wants an optional estimate toggle.

  6. #43845 — v2 service spawns MCP server pair per project directory
    With ~53 cataloged projects, startup spawns dozens of stdio MCP processes instead of one set. A resource-exhaustion regression in the new service model.

  7. #61695 — Host-side restarts surface to model as "user doesn't want to proceed"
    Claude Agent sessions misreport infrastructure restarts as user cancellations, corrupting agent reasoning. Reproduced and provider-specific.

  8. #62872 — Partial config write kills all sessions (no last-good fallback)
    A transient partial write to opencode.jsonc rejects the entire config with no fallback, killing running sessions. A strong argument for atomic config reloads; a fix PR is already open.

  9. #62948 — Git polling loop saturates CPU on large worktrees
    Tight-loop git status scans on a 1.3M-file worktree peg the CPU. Relevant to anyone running OpenCode inside a $HOME-rooted repo.

  10. #62923 — Code Mode execute returns null for everything
    The Code Mode execute tool is effectively broken in v2.2.6 — even thrown errors return null. Blocks the Code Mode feature entirely.

Honorable mentions: #62934 (Android 17 missing ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK), #62981 (fixed-width variant flyout UI), #62641 (step-limit assistant-prompt rejected by no-prefill models).

4. Key PR Progress

  1. #62976 — opencode-pty protocol v8 (jlongster)
    First of three stacked PRs replacing #61876; updates the PTY protocol foundation.

  2. #62978 — Run shell commands in the process daemon across restarts (jlongster)
    Third stacked PR: shell commands survive restarts by living in the daemon — a durability win for long sessions.

  3. #62974 — Keep last-good config on partial write (iMumd)
    Fixes #62872 by retaining the last valid config during non-atomic writes — prevents mass session death.

  4. #62904 — Keep managed service ports out of ephemeral range (2SinceJuly)
    Fixes #62891's port-49374 collision by extending the Windows-only workaround to Linux/macOS.

  5. #62984 — Rank Code Mode tool search with name-weighted BM25 (rekram1-node)
    Replaces substring scoring with BM25, down-weighting noise words like list/get — meaningful relevance improvement.

  6. #62982 — Update MCP SDK to 2.4.0 (rekram1-node)
    Brings the Skills extension (SEP-2640) and rebuilds the client patch; groundwork for future skills support.

  7. #62963 — Keep browser tools across screen lock (jlongster)
    Auto-detaches/re-attaches browser tools on lock/unlock instead of requiring an always-on setting.

  8. #62983 — Deliver keyed instruction updates to Claude (iMumd)
    Fixes #62916: system messages in history now reach the claude-agent provider.

  9. #62979 — Send EVREN thinking controls as booleans (cemililik)
    Provider-compat fix for EVREN's OpenAI-compatible gateway.

  10. #60055 — Report unverified clipboard delivery in TUI (Chubercik)
    Stops falsely claiming "Copied to clipboard"; closes #59664. Small but high-trust UX fix.

Site perf cleanup: a batch of adamdotdevin PRs (#62971, #62965, #62966, #62962, #62964, #62980) cut idle polling, deferred nav/console loading, and fixed media caching.

5. Hot Discussions

No Discussion data was provided for this period.

6. Feature Request Trends

  • Payments & account management: crypto payment for OpenCode Go (#23153, closed, 👍67 — the highest-voted item in this window), email change/removal in Zen (#18654), and localization of the console page (#62768).
  • Session UX: pinning sessions in the experimental Inbox (#62772) and OSC 7501 reporting for done/error states (#60411) — extending the existing terminal notification protocol.
  • Cross-platform robustness: Windows PowerShell should normalize en/em dashes and curly quotes rather than reject commands (#61704).
  • Cost transparency: opt-in catalog-price estimates when providers report $0 (#59861).
  • Fleet management: opencode join for hub-managed multi-host node fleets with centralized session discovery (#44760, closed).
  • Agent transparency: failed MCP servers should be distinguishable from unconfigured ones (#62973).

7. Developer Pain Points

  1. Free-tier quota state is unreliable. The 339-comment mega-thread (#59387) and duplicate reports (#58687, #62783) show reset timers that don't fire and limits that persist across model switches — the single loudest complaint.
  2. Compaction is the weakest link. Two separate reproduced bugs (#43250 budget overrun, #50814 tool-call-as-text) make long agent sessions unpredictable in both cost and correctness.
  3. v2 service lifecycle regressions. Port collisions (#62891), per-project MCP process storms (#43845), CPU-saturating git polling (#62948), and no last-good config fallback (#62872) all point to hardening needs in the new daemon architecture.
  4. Provider compatibility friction. LM Studio API-key discovery (#51570), Claude Agent restart misinterpretation (#61695), no-prefill models rejecting step-limit prompts (#62641), and EVREN boolean controls (#62979) show the multi-provider matrix needs more conformance testing.
  5. Local/desktop setup issues recur. "No models available" on Desktop 2.2.6 (#62781), missing custom provider option (#59603), and Android 17 LAN permission (#62934) suggest onboarding gaps across clients.

Digest generated 2026-11-10 from github.com/anomalyco/opencode. All links point to the canonical issue/PR pages.

Pi — earendil-works/pi

Pi Community Digest — 2026-11-10

1. Today's Highlights

A heavy triage day: the Windows sink-thread (#7547) exploded to 95 comments, surfacing a cluster of Windows/PowerShell/stderr bugs that are being systematically fixed by petrroll in a batch of PRs. On the model-integration side, regressions in StringEnum typing (P0) and a Claude model header incompatibility are the highest-severity items. No new releases in the last 24h.

2. Releases

None in the last 24h. (Note: v1.5.0 shipped earlier and is the source of several P0 issues below — see #11869, #11892, #11769.)

3. Hot Issues

  1. #7547 — [Windows] How do you use Pi on Windows? (95 comments, OPEN) The flagship Windows omnibus thread. Community is enumerating the many ways Pi is run on Windows (native, Git Bash, WSL, MSYS2/mintty) and where effort should go: core fixes vs. delegating to extensions. Highest-engagement issue of the day. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/7547

  2. #11869 — [bug, prio:p0] StringEnum in Pi 1.5.0 breaks compile-time typing (OPEN, 👍3) A 1.5.0 regression: StringEnum no longer derives from typebox, so tool-parameter fields degrade to unknown. Breaks downstream TypeScript tool authors — hence the P0 badge and upvotes. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11869

  3. #11773 — [inprogress, prio:p0] Upgrade Token Plan branding and gateway setup (OPEN) Rebranding Token Plan to 千问 AI 平台 / QwenCloud with new default endpoints. P0 because it affects default configuration for new users. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11773

  4. #3200 — Support video/audio content in prompt command (OPEN, 👍8) Highest-upvoted open request: extend the prompt RPC to forward audio/video alongside images for multimodal models. Clear demand signal for multimodal RPC. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/3200

  5. #5103 — [bug] pi-windows-x64.zip can't detect git-bash from PATH (CLOSED, 24 comments) Long-running Windows bug now resolved. Illustrative of the Windows environment-detection pain cluster. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5103

  6. #9262 — find tool: glob with Windows separators silently returns nothing (CLOSED) Silent-failure class bug: src\**\*.ts returns zero results with no error, leading agents to wrongly conclude files don't exist. Now closed. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9262

  7. #11892 — [bug] pi-durable 1.5.0: tasks stuck in waiting/completing (CLOSED) A 1.5.0 regression in pi-durable where tasks never leave waiting/completing even after dependencies finish. Reproduced with MemoryStorage. Closed. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11892

  8. #11969 — [bug, untriaged] Fable 5.2 requires new headers (CLOSED, 👍1) Anthropic rejects requests to Fable 5.2 with claude_code_version_too_old (400). Fixed quickly — see PR #11970. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11969

  9. #11926 — [bug, no-action] Transient states treated as permanent errors (CLOSED) A 429 is shown in red and permanently logged as a hard error rather than a transient state. Important UX distinction for session logs. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11926

  10. #11676 — [inprogress] pi-durable: Harness.close() leaks provider session resources (OPEN) After a real Codex response, a Node process retains a WebSocket + 5-min idle timer, preventing clean exit. Deterministic repro. Fix in PR #11961. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11676

4. Key PR Progress

  1. #11970 — fix(ai): bump Claude Code user-agent for Fable 5.2 (CLOSED) Bumps advertised Claude Code version 2.1.280 → 2.1.321 to clear the claude_code_version_too_old 400. Direct fix for #11969. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11970

  2. #11964 — fix(coding-agent): native exit codes in powershell on Windows PS 5.1 (CLOSED) Solves #8842: PS 5.1 misclassifies stderr progress output as failures. Uses native exit codes for correctness. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11964

  3. #11967 — fix(coding-agent): read/edit/write UTF-16 files with BOM (OPEN) Handles UTF-16LE/BE BOM files (common from PS 5 Out-File, reg export). Big correctness win for Windows users; read/write/tools currently emit U+FFFD. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11967

  4. #11966 — fix(coding-agent): stop writing to terminal while TUI draws (OPEN) Fixes #11264: rogue stdout/stderr writes corrupt TUI screen state. Important stability fix for interactive mode. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11966

  5. #11968 — fix(tui,coding-agent): fullscreen scroll frames O(viewport) (OPEN) Perf fix: fullscreen scrolling rebuilt the whole transcript every frame (~60 fps). Reduces to O(viewport) rendering. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11968

  6. #11961 — fix(durable): clean up provider resources on harness close (OPEN) Releases pi-ai provider resources after active tasks complete so processes exit cleanly. Addresses #11676. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11961

  7. #11952 — fix(coding-agent): run bash alone, other calls in parallel (CLOSED) Serializes bash (executionMode: sequential) so paired read calls don't read half-written output files. Fixes a real agent race condition (#11950). https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11952

  8. #10969 — fix(coding-agent): reuse unchanged codemode highlighting (CLOSED) Caches per-row syntax highlighting; avoids re-highlighting the whole script on every result-progress/timer tick. Performance win for codemode. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10969

  9. #11972 — fix(coding-agent): match Windows find path patterns across all fd versions (CLOSED) Makes find path-pattern matching consistent regardless of installed fd version (pre/post 10.5.1 glob semantics differ). https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11972

  10. #11957 — fix(coding-agent): report already-declared MCP tools in tool_search (OPEN) tool_search no longer answers "No matching tools found" for tools the model already has (e.g. direct MCP tools). Reduces weaker-model confusion. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11957

5. Hot Discussions

No dedicated discussion data was provided in this dataset. (Most community discussion is occurring in the comments of issue #7547; see Hot Issues above.)

6. Feature Request Trends

  • Multimodal & media: Video/audio support in the prompt RPC (#3200, highest upvotes); image-heavy tool results via file references for Codex (#8617); aggregate image budgets for 413 recovery (#8351).
  • Session/storage management: Permanent conversation deletion in pi-durable (#11026); persistence of chosen folder for moved sessions (#11060); read-only viewer semantics correcting for JSONL recovery writes (#11939).
  • Tool exposure control: Per-tool MCP enable/disable from the /mcp Tools view without hand-editing toolExposure (#11526); actionable edit failure diagnostics distinguishing "file changed" from "oldText mismatch" (#11943).
  • TUI/UX polish: Relative Markdown link OSC 8 target fixes (#10993), mintty modifier-key handling (#11935), WSL image paste via empty bracketed paste (#11259).

Trend summary: Windows ecosystem parity dominates, followed by multimodal input handling and stronger agent-facing tool-result diagnostics.

7. Developer Pain Points

  • Windows is a first-class pain surface. Recurring, high-volume themes: PATH/git-bash detection (#5103), path-separator globs silently failing (#9262, #11972), PowerShell 5.1 stderr→failure misclassification (#8842, #11964), installer aborting on npm warn stderr (#11944), UTF-16 BOM files (#11967), and terminal-key handling in mintty (#11935). The #7547 thread (95 comments) is a direct community call to consolidate Windows support investment.
  • 1.5.0 regressions erode trust. StringEnum typing break (#11869, P0), pi-durable task-stuck states (#11892), and the un-bumped stable branch for Nix users (#11769) all trace to the 1.5.0 release window — suggesting release/QA hygiene needs attention.
  • Silent failures are the most damaging bug class. find returning zero results without error (#9262) and tool_search claiming no matches for real tools (#11921) actively mislead agents; developers want loud, actionable errors.
  • Resource lifecycle leaks. Harness.close() leaving WebSockets and idle timers alive (#11676) blocks clean process exit — a recurring class for long-running/embedded use.
  • Missing diagnostics increase debugging time. The edit tool's single generic failure message (#11943) and transient errors being logged as permanent (#11926) are frequently cited friction points.

Data source: github.com/earendil-works/pi — generated 2026-11-10.

Qwen Code — QwenLM/qwen-code

Qwen Code Community Digest — 2026-11-10

Today's Highlights

Qwen Code shipped v0.27.1 alongside coordinated SDK releases, and the community is heavily focused on the Managed Agent / Web Shell expansion (channels, webhook delivery, session management). Meanwhile, CI stability remains the single largest source of issue noise — multiple Managed Agent gate, E2E Tests, and Qwen Code CI failures are actively being triaged, including a main-branch Java compilation break caused by duplicate case labels.

Releases

v0.27.1 (release)

  • feat(core): Active shell is now named in the startup context (#16491)
  • No known breaking changes.

Companion releases bundled with this version:

  • sdk-typescript v0.1.31 — bundles CLI 0.27.1
  • sdk-typescript v0.1.29 — backfilled release (npm publish succeeded, but the release-branch push step failed; see #16490)
  • desktop v0.27.1 — includes provider docs for Wally under OpenAI-compatible providers (#16529)

Hot Issues

  1. #14724 — Main CI failed: Managed Agent gate — no test identified (282 comments). The longest-running CI tracking issue; a persistent gate failure that cannot be attributed to a specific test. High noise, still unresolved.

  2. #16712 — main's Java lane fails to compile — duplicate case labels in SurfaceAdmissionAcceptanceTest (P1, closed). Broke the Java lane for every PR via test-compilation failure. Fast turnaround (closed same day) shows release-blocking responsiveness.

  3. #16683 — Qwen Code Desktop 0.27 fails on Intel x64 Mac (P1). Fatal V8 Check failed: 12 == (*__error()) at runtime startup. A serious platform regression for a segment of macOS users.

  4. #16140 — Shell redirect extractor drops N> (fd≥3), >\|, and no-space cd>file forms (P1, security). Deny rules for Write/Edit cannot fire on these redirect spellings — a permission-bypass class bug.

  5. #13139 — Shell permission analyzer: residual phantom-cwd entrances for quoting-artifact cd targets (P1, security). Follow-up to an earlier cwd-escalation fix; three entrances of the same family remain open.

  6. #16757 — Non-UTF-8 ANSI-C bytes collapse to U+FFFD, so shell path guards miss the file bash touches (P2, security). Encoding mismatch between the guard's decoder and bash's raw-byte filesystem semantics.

  7. #15327 — tracking(core): run every surface on one agent loop behind experimental.unifiedAgentLoop (P1). The architectural umbrella issue consolidating the agent loop across CLI, OpenTUI, ACP, and daemon surfaces — directly driving several PRs below.

  8. #16690 — GitHub channel: surface API budget and protect the mention lane from watch spend (P2, closed). Budget-aware GitHub channel behavior; closed quickly, signaling active channel hardening.

  9. #16546 — feat(managed-agent): expose sidebar panel capabilities in WebShell (P2). Capability-parity matrix comparing control-plane, WebShell, and data-agent REST surfaces — a roadmap artifact for managed sessions.

  10. #16766 — Generated UI card stuck at "Loading the interactive view…" in Desktop (macOS WKWebView); renders in Chromium (P2). Tauri/WKWebView-specific rendering gap in the experimental Generated UI tool.

Key PR Progress

  1. #16743 — feat(cli): send OpenTUI's model rounds through the shared agent loop. PR 4a of #15327; brings OpenTUI to parity with Ink on the unified loop and extends the TUI parity suite.

  2. #16324 — feat(web-shell): let managed sessions reuse the host shell. Removes the second "managed look" chrome; managed pages inherit host header/workspace/phase badge when showManagedSessionHeader: false.

  3. #16736 — feat(web-shell): configure the WeChat channel with in-browser QR login. WeChat joins the channel platform list with QR rendering, scan-state reporting, and account panel.

  4. #16724 — feat(channels): QR-login management contract + QQ config surface. Adds an optional interactive QR-login capability to the channel management contract, with daemon-persistable values.

  5. #16758 — feat(managed-agent): private BTW and session recap. Durable, actor-private follow-ups and manual/auto session recap, including ACTIVE sessions whose Runtime was reclaimed.

  6. #16023 — feat(managed-agent): share resident external Workspace across sessions. Turns Workspace closing into a membership release rather than teardown — a meaningful resource-efficiency change.

  7. #16498 — feat(managed-agent): Tool v4 execution measurements. Attested, bounded numeric measurements frozen with results and persisted pre-ack; feeds diagnostics panels.

  8. #15936 — fix(core): reduce or refuse a compression request that cannot fit its window. Enforces a 4,096-token minimum summary reservation and recovers once on context-length rejection.

  9. #16598 — fix(core): keep persisted-output stubs out of microcompaction clearing. Stops replacing spill stubs (path, sha256, preview) with the bare cleared placeholder.

  10. #14360 — fix(core): treat git remote show as non-read-only. Closes an auto-mode egress bypass where a network-touching command was auto-approved on the read-only fast path.

Hot Discussions

No GitHub Discussions data was provided in this dataset; section omitted.

Feature Request Trends

  • Channel & webhook ecosystem expansion — A clear cluster of requests (#16751, #16752, #16753, #16724, #16736) asks for outbound platform webhooks (DingTalk first), configurable delivery targets, per-platform connection methods, and Web Shell configuration flows. WeChat and QQ are the leading platform integrations.
  • Unified agent loop across surfaces — #15327 and its PR chain (#16743) represent the dominant architectural direction: one packages/core loop serving CLI, TUI, ACP, daemon, and Web Shell.
  • Managed Agent session lifecycle — Requests for sidebar capability parity (#16546), resident workspace reuse (#16023), private BTW/recap (#16758), and session reuse of host chrome (#16324) point toward maturing multi-session management.
  • API budget / poll efficiency for integrations — #16690, #16691 (conditional requests / ETags), and #16692 (batched GraphQL PR watches) show demand for rate-limit-aware, low-cost polling in the GitHub channel.

Developer Pain Points

  • CI instability dominates the issue tracker. Managed Agent gate, E2E Tests, and Qwen Code CI failures generate the highest-comment threads (#14724, #16672, #11680, #11678), often with "no test identified" — making regressions hard to attribute and slowing every PR.
  • Main-branch breakage has real blast radius. #16712 (duplicate case labels) blocked the Java lane for all PRs until fixed — repeated main-branch breakage erodes contributor confidence.
  • Shell permission analyzer edge cases recur. Multiple P1 security issues (#16140, #13139, #16757) target redirect parsing, quoting artifacts, and encoding mismatches — a sustained correctness burden in the permission-guard subsystem.
  • Platform-specific regressions — macOS Intel x64 startup crash (#16683) and WKWebView rendering failures (#16766) suggest Desktop packaging/webview coverage gaps.
  • Session-state and telemetry fidelity — Spurious "request was interrupted" banners on clean tool-call turn endings (#16767) and TPS excluding time-to-first-token (#16714) reflect user-visible trust issues in state reporting and metrics.

OpenClaw 项目深度报告

OpenClaw 项目摘要 — 2026-11-10

1. 今日概览

OpenClaw 仍处于高速维护阶段，过去 24 小时内没有新版本发布，但分类处置与工程吞吐量可观：共触及 500 个 issue 和 500 个 PR，其中 208 个 issue 已关闭、131 个 PR 已合并/关闭。未决积压倾向于稳定性工作——崩溃循环/重启可靠性、SQLite/会话状态完整性，以及 Windows/Kubernetes 部署失败主导了评论最多的 issue。PR 活动集中于小而精准的修复（CLI 错误暴露、WebChat 渲染、Android/Telegram 渠道行为），而非大型功能。整体健康度中等偏良好：维护者响应积极，许多 PR 已“可供维护者审阅”，但持续存在的一批 P0/P1 可靠性缺陷（Windows 启动、崩溃后更新路径、会话卡死）表明更新/重启子系统是项目当前的薄弱环节。

2. 版本发布

无。 过去 24 小时内未发布任何新版本或预发布版本。

底层需求： 最热帖围绕单一主题——可信赖的重启与更新。用户无法可靠地从崩溃中恢复或应用修复，这既阻碍采用，又将瞬时 bug 变成永久性中断。第二个主题是会话持久性：回收/锁/检查点失败使 agent 搁浅，直至人工干预。MCP 强制转换帖反映了日益增长的第三方集成需求，以及就工具调用适配器做出产品决策的必要性。

7. 用户反馈摘要

痛点

  • 更新/重启可靠性是主要挫败来源 — 用户描述需要“多次重试”和数小时的误诊。#173313（配置获取屏蔽敏感值）据称在一次 Funnel 恢复期间导致 4+ 小时的中断验证循环。
  • 静默降级：会话卡死 90+ 分钟；重启后 agent 变为“降级”；崩溃恢复使 agent 永久拒绝 chat.history/models.list。
  • 诊断陷阱：status --deep 和 status --agent 吞掉真实错误（已由 PR #196073、#196081 处理）；gateway restart 报告失败却以 0 退出（#161158）。
  • 部署摩擦 存在于 Windows（schtasks）、Kubernetes（fsGroup）和 RHEL 8（glibc）。

积极信号

  • 维护者在高严重程度帖中明显参与（30/27/21 条评论），许多 PR 被标记为“可供维护者审阅”或附带截图/证据。
  • 用户提交详细、高质量的复现，包含环境和版本数据，表明技术投入度高的用户群。

情绪： 沮丧但参与。满意度取决于重启/更新可靠性；在添加功能之前修复运维基座有明确意愿。

横向生态对比

跨项目对比报告 — 个人 AI 助手 / Agent 开源生态

快照日期： 2026-11-10 | 项目： OpenClaw、Hermes Agent、IronClaw、QwenPaw、ZeroClaw

1. 生态概览

个人 AI 助手开源领域正分化为两大阵营：成熟的 "Claw 家族"运行时（以 OpenClaw 为参考实现，加上衍生项目 Hermes、ZeroClaw、IronClaw），围绕 agent 运行时、消息网关和插件生态构建；以及应用层助手（QwenPaw），聚焦本地模型运行时和控制台 UX。整个生态的主要工程负担已从功能获取转向运维可靠性：崩溃恢复、重启/更新路径、会话状态持久化和安全隔离如今占据了维护者的大部分精力。安全审查正在快速成熟——ZeroClaw 对每个开放的 PR 都执行正式的 S0 严重级别审查流水线，Hermes/OpenClaw 本周期也都修复了安全边界 bug。本地优先推理（MLX、llama.cpp、Ollama）和插件/市场分发是两条最清晰的绿地赛道，而 Windows 仍是生态中最脆弱的平台。

关键解读： OpenClaw 的原始 Issue/PR 体量约为同行的 10 倍——它是生态的引力中心。QwenPaw 是本周期唯一交付带 tag 发布的项目。ZeroClaw 是唯一合并队列完全阻塞的项目，使其高活跃度具有欺骗性。

3. OpenClaw 的定位

相对同行的优势

  • 表面积规模： 24 小时内触及 500 个 Issue + 500 个 PR，而 Hermes 和 ZeroClaw 为 50/50。这造就了生态中最快的“发现到修复”闭环——例如 PR #196294 将知识记忆保存延迟从约 11 秒降至约 2 秒。
  • 生态引力： ZeroClaw 提供显式的 zeroclaw migrate openclaw-config 导入器（#12348），Hermes/ZeroClaw 均继承 Claw 家族的架构假设。OpenClaw 是事实上的配置与概念标准。
  • 集成广度： Control UI、WebChat、Android、Telegram、Kubernetes、MCP、SQLite 支撑的记忆/搜索——没有同行能在单一仓库中匹配这一集成矩阵。

技术路线差异

  • 以 SQLite 为中心的状态模型（会话回收、检查点、vec0 记忆搜索）——这是 OpenClaw 的标志性押注，也是其标志性负债（见 P0 会话卡死问题簇）。Hermes 等同行依赖 REST 会话 API（/api/sessions），QwenPaw 则依赖本地运行时栈。
  • 将更新/重启子系统作为一等关注点——没有同行暴露如此多的运维工具（status --deep、gateway restart、openclaw update），也没有同行在其中存在如此多的 bug。#193962“元 bug”（对先前修复的修复无法通过更新器触达）是 OpenClaw 规模独有的问题。

社区规模对比

  • Issue 互动印证了更大、技术投入更深的用户群：头部讨论串有 30/27/21 条评论，包含详细的环境复现，而 Hermes 为 11/10/9，QwenPaw 上限为 4 条评论。OpenClaw 的用户在生产环境中运行它（K8s、RHEL 8、Windows 企业版）——这是同行尚未达到的成熟度信号。

4. 共同技术焦点领域

需求 项目 具体需求
可信的重启/更新与崩溃恢复 OpenClaw（P0：#170956、#193962、#144336）、Hermes（恢复 provider 修复 #151956）、QwenPaw（#8616 启动 AppHang） 重启不得使 agent 搁浅；更新器必须能交付自身的修复；SIGUSR1 时干净关闭。
会话状态持久化 / 无静默丢失 OpenClaw（#157255 90 分钟卡死、#192141 丢弃用户文本）、Hermes（#143290 过期 /stop 丢弃下一轮、#121750 P0 压缩归档未见的轮次）、QwenPaw（#8521 间歇性空响应） 投递保证优先于功能；fork/reset 语义在 CLI、REST 和桌面端必须无歧义。
安全隔离与审批范围正确性 ZeroClaw（S0 批次：#12304–#12311）、Hermes（#152125 审批者绑定、#53674 频道发帖绕过）、QwenPaw（#8642 MCP 策略围栏） 沙箱文件访问、跨会话附加防护、审批绑定到请求者、失败即关闭的默认值。
Windows / 企业 SKU 可靠性 OpenClaw（schtasks，约 5 个月的 Windows 问题）、QwenPaw（LTSC 启动、长路径、GBK 编码 #8234、中文路径 #8502）、Hermes（#152202 非交互式插件更新） 非默认区域设置、遗留编码、冻结构建的依赖校验。
第三方 / OpenAI 兼容 provider 兼容性 QwenPaw（#8603 工具调用序列化、#8512/#8615 网关错误格式）、Hermes（#149511 定价覆盖）、OpenClaw（#166133 MCP 整数强制转换） 优雅处理网关特有的错误格式；正确的工具调用适配器；按自动化配置 provider 路由。
插件/市场分发完整性 QwenPaw（#8595 元数据缺失、#8644 频道激活）、Hermes（一天内 4 个目录 PR）、OpenClaw（MCP 适配器需求） 安装路径必须同时通过 UI 和 CLI 可用；插件生命周期必须由框架管理。
本地模型运行时 QwenPaw（MLX + llama.cpp GPU 栈 #8647–#8649、Ollama num_ctx #8236）、OpenClaw（记忆/搜索调优） 第一方 Apple Silicon 支持、GPU 卸载可见性、正确的上下文窗口大小设置。

跨领域洞察： 五个活跃项目中有四个独立地撞上同一类 bug——一条静默丢失数据的恢复或续接路径。这是生态级的架构缺口，而非单个项目的缺陷。

5. 差异化分析

维度 OpenClaw Hermes Agent QwenPaw ZeroClaw
主要焦点 全栈 agent 运行时 + Control UI + 记忆 消息网关加固（Telegram 优先）、插件目录 桌面助手 + 本地模型运行时 + 控制台 UX 安全多频道运行时、远程 OIDC 接入
目标用户 生产运维者、K8s/企业、自托管者 群聊/多界面消息用户、插件作者 桌面/Apple Silicon 用户、中文区域 Windows 用户 对安全敏感的自托管守护进程运维者
架构押注 SQLite 状态 + 网关 + MCP 适配器 基于租约的房间/配置模型 + REST 会话契约 冻结桌面构建 + MLX/llama.cpp 本地栈 原生 Rust 频道（XMPP/OMEMO）、沙箱执行
发布节奏 高速维护，本周期无 tag 趋于 0.23 线 快速 beta 节奏（已发布 beta.3） 被 CI 门禁阻塞
独特风险 规模化下运维基座脆弱 被搁置的 P0 决策阻塞 PR 打包/依赖路径的 beta 回归 审查发现的安全债务 + 合并死锁

显著分歧： ZeroClaw 是唯一将安全审查作为产出入 S0 发现的合并前门禁的项目——与 OpenClaw 分流驱动的模式在工程文化上存在实质差异。QwenPaw 是唯一投入第一方本地推理的项目，这使其与 OpenClaw 的云适配器假设形成对立。

6. 社区动能与成熟度

活跃度分层

  • 第一层 — 生态锚点： OpenClaw（500/500，分流主导）。成熟但背负运维债务。
  • 第二层 — 收敛中的稳定器： Hermes（32 个 issue 关闭、Telegram 清扫、14 个合并）和 QwenPaw（发布 beta 周期、9 个合并、3 位首次贡献者）。两者都在关闭速度快于开启速度。
  • 第三层 — 受阻/休眠： ZeroClaw（贡献者产出高，合并队列死亡——动能真实但无法兑现）和 IronClaw（无活动；可能休眠或尚未发布）。

迭代 vs. 稳定

  • 快速迭代： QwenPaw（新的 MLX/GPU 运行时栈在推进，UX 打磨 PR 当天提交）和 Hermes（插件目录扩张——一天内 4 个提交）。
  • 负载下稳定： OpenClaw 和 Hermes 都处于加固阶段——OpenClaw 在重启/会话上，Hermes 在 Telegram 正确性上。两者都未添加重大功能。
  • 停滞： ZeroClaw 需要一个依赖决策（#12320）才能将大量已验证修复的积压转化为发布。这是生态中杠杆率最高的解锁点。

成熟度排名（综合）： OpenClaw > Hermes ≈ QwenPaw > ZeroClaw >> IronClaw。值得注意的是，QwenPaw 的发布门禁纪律（自动开启 4 小时跨平台验证 issue #8643）比其 bug 体量所暗示的更成熟。

7. 趋势信号（面向 AI agent 开发者）

  1. 可靠性就是新功能。 在 OpenClaw、Hermes 和 QwenPaw 中，用户明确将投递保证置于新能力之上——静默消息丢失、过期 stop 丢弃轮次、崩溃后卡死是呼声最高的抱怨。行动： 在任何 agent 循环中设计幂等续接和显式的“消息已落定”确认。
  2. 恢复路径回归是最危险的 bug 类别。 OpenClaw 的 #193962（修复无法通过更新器触达）和 ZeroClaw 的 #12330（静默回退到本地守护进程）表明回归健康的路径测试不足。行动： 用更新器测试更新器；将故障转移视为一等状态机，而非 catch 块。
  3. 安全审查正在左移，前置到合并前。 ZeroClaw 针对开放 PR head 的 S0 发现（沙箱点文件访问、审批范围绕过、跨会话附加）设定了新标杆。行动： 要求审批绑定到请求身份，并默认使用沙箱范围的文件访问。
  4. 本地优先推理正在进入助手层。 QwenPaw 的 MLX/llama.cpp/GPU 控制栈和 Ollama num_ctx 修复表明桌面助手将拥有自己的推理运行时。行动： 尽早抽象模型后端；不要硬编码云适配器假设。
  5. 平台对等是信任问题，而非锦上添花。 Windows（schtasks、长路径、GBK）、RHEL 8（glibc）、iPhone Safari（requestIdleCallback）和 Linux 半透明都产生了超额挫败感。行动： 将非默认区域/编码和冻结构建环境视为一级测试目标。
  6. 生态互操作正在围绕 OpenClaw 约定整合。 ZeroClaw 的迁移导入器和共享的 Claw 家族配置概念表明事实标准正在形成。行动： 对新进入者，将配置/会话语义与 OpenClaw 对齐，以继承工具链和迁入路径。
  7. 插件市场是下一个可靠性前沿。 安装路径失败（#8595）、冻结构建激活回归（#8644）和框架管理的生命周期 PR（#8431）都指向同一方向。行动： 在扩展目录之前设计插件依赖校验和生命周期管理。

给决策者的底线： OpenClaw 是生态的参考实现，应作为兼容性基线跟踪；Hermes 和 QwenPaw 分别是消息网关和桌面/本地运行时用例最健康的活跃押注；ZeroClaw 拥有最强的安全姿态，但需要先解决其 CI 门禁才能发布；IronClaw 本周期无信号。2026 年决定性的工程问题是运维信任——重启、恢复和投递保证——而非功能广度。

QwenPaw Local 的托管式 MLX 引擎 + GPU 控制（Apple Silicon） #8646 非常高 — 维护者 PR 栈 #8647/#8648/#8649 中已实现。预计下个 beta 发布。
UX：思考块与工具卡的视觉风格一致；停止左边缘跳动 #8650 中 — 小型、范围明确的 UI 打磨；适合补丁版本。
UX："执行型"工具调用应显示人类可读的意图 #8612 高，已在推进中 — #8638 为 execute_shell_command 添加了可选的 title 参数（同时修复了一个验证问题）。
浏览器标签页标题应反映当前会话名称 #8605 中 — 简单的控制台变更；近期可实现。
将助手回复的选中内容引用到后续草稿中 （PR #8609） PR 中已实现；可能下个版本发布。
UI 切换开关以恢复旧控制台布局（隐含于 #8521） #8521 低/不确定 — 历史上维护者很少提供双 UI 模式；更可能是解决具体的摩擦点（模型切换）。

对 v2.3.0 GA / beta.4 的预测： 本地 MLX + GPU 控制、shell 卡意图标题、引用到草稿以及内存搜索性能修复是最强的候选。UX 一致性（#8650）有可能作为快速跟进项。

7. 用户反馈总结

痛点：

  • Windows 是主要的摩擦面。 LTSC 上的启动失败（#8616）、长路径/checkpoint 问题（#8627）、扩展路径 SQLite 缺陷（#8585，现已修复）以及中文路径 HTML 预览失败（#8502，现已修复）均集中在 Windows 配置上——尤其是非默认区域设置和企业 SKU。
  • 插件/渠道生态可靠性。 多份独立报告（#8595、#8644、#8553、#8627）表明插件安装和渠道激活是 2.3.x beta 中最不稳定的子系统。
  • 新控制台 UX 不满。 用户报告重新设计的 UI 感觉比旧版更慢、信息密度更低，具体抱怨包括模型切换的人体工学以及每次按键的剪贴板失败（#8521）。工具卡可读性是一个反复出现的主题（#8612、#8650）。
  • 第三方提供商兼容性。 运行自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点（kimi、Strata 等网关）的用户遇到工具调用序列化损坏（#8603）和无法识别的网关错误格式（#8512、#8615）。

积极信号：

  • 用户提交的缺陷报告质量高、范围明确，附带环境详情和复现步骤，这与维护者的响应速度相关（今日更新的前 20 个 PR 中有 19 个）。
  • 三个首次贡献者 PR 处于活跃状态（#8606 文档死链修复、#8623 内存性能、#8642 MCP 策略防护）——这是社区投入的健康信号。
  • Apple Silicon 用户积极参与，其首要请求（MLX）正由维护者团队交付，这应能转化为满意度。

8. 待办事项关注

需要维护者关注的事项（较旧或可见度较低但影响重大）：

  1. #8234 — fix(tools)：在 read/edit/grep 中解码 GBK/CP936 而非静默丢弃字节 — 自 2026-10-14 开启（约 27 天）。解决中文 Windows 用户旧版文本文件的静默数据丢失问题。对庞大区域用户群体具有高价值；已处于"审查中"状态数周。
  2. #8236 — fix(ollama)：根据 num_ctx 设定上下文窗口大小而非默认 128k — 自 2026-10-14 开启。本地 Ollama 用户获得错误的上下文窗口假设，导致截断或溢出错误。与本地模型推进直接相关；应与 #8647–#8649 栈协调。
  3. #8170 — fix(console)：容忍 DOM 变更渲染错误 + chunk 错误重试（已 rebase #7889） — 自 2026-10-10 开启（约 31 天），已 rebase 一次。渲染错误容忍可能与 #8521 中的间歇性 UI 失败相关；鉴于用户对控制台稳定性的抱怨，值得优先处理。
  4. #8431 — feat：将本地 Whisper 转换为框架管理生命周期的 SDK 插件 — 大型（XXXL）PR，自 2026-10-26 开启；涉及插件生命周期，而这正是产生最多 beta 缺陷的子系统（#8644、#8553）。在与插件依赖重构叠加之前需要架构审查。
  5. #8606 — docs：修复 5 个失效外部链接 — 首次贡献者，小型低风险；快速合并将是一个良好的入门信号。

维护者建议： 优先处理 (a) #8644 打包构建渠道激活回归作为 beta.3 热修复，(b) 合并长期待处理的 #8234/#8236 本地化/本地模型修复，以及 (c) 对冻结构建依赖验证路径进行专项审计，以在 GA 之前阻止反复出现的 Windows beta 回归。

数据来源：github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw，活动窗口 2026-11-09 → 2026-11-10。所有链接指向相应的 GitHub issue/PR 页面。

ZeroClaw — zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw

ZeroClaw 项目摘要 — 2026-11-10

1. 今日概览

ZeroClaw 当前处于发布阻塞状态：Issue #12320 报告称 RUSTSEC-2026-0459（libsqlite3-sys 0.38.2 / 捆绑 SQLite 3.53.2）在每次 CI 运行时都导致 Security 任务失败，进而级联引发 CI Required Gate 失败——这意味着没有任何 PR 可以合并，合并队列已停滞。活动量仍然很高（24 小时内涉及 35 个 issue 和 50 个 PR），但严重偏向审查发现：单一审查者（IftekharUddin）针对开放的 PR head 提交了一批 S0 安全发现（#12304–#12312、#12305、#12306、#12309、#12310、#12311），tidux 提交了一个大型 zerocode OIDC 登录 PR（#12317）并伴随一系列后续 issue（#12331–#12340）。未发布任何版本，与门禁阻塞状态一致。总体评估：贡献者吞吐量健康，但由于 CI 阻塞及若干关键的前合并安全发现，合并健康度下降。

2. 发布

本窗口内无发布。规划提示：所有带发布标签的工作当前均被 #12320 阻塞。

3. 项目进展

今日合并/关闭的 PR：

  • #12348（已关闭，XL）— feat(migrate): import OpenClaw config, agents, and workspaces：新增 zeroclaw migrate openclaw-config，映射 providers、fallback chains 和 agents（balanced risk preset）。重要的生态互操作功能。
  • #11933（已关闭，XS）— fix(web): keep the chat header on screen in narrow layouts：移动端聊天的响应式修复。
  • #11920（已关闭，XS）— feat(web): toggle to keep the live Thinking box collapsed（关闭 #11919）：推理模型的 UX 改进。
  • #12342（已关闭，XS）— 文档：zerocode OIDC 的有界运行时放置例外（#12317），解除该功能的合并契约阻塞。

已关闭 issue：#10359（审计日志哈希链投毒——先前存在，现已关闭）、#11009（别名重命名未级联权限配置）、#12064（Discord 对等机器人审批绕过）、#12087（工具开关双重保存）、#11952（- 前缀的相对数据目录）、#12312（OIDC 发现端点策略缺口）、#11919（Thinking 框）。

4. 社区热点

  1. Issue #12320 — CI 安全门禁失败（S1，3 条评论）。杠杆率最高的线程：每个发布和合并都依赖解决该 RUSTSEC 公告。需要要么升级依赖，要么提供有范围、有文档的公告例外。
  2. PR #12317 — feat(zerocode): pairing-free OIDC login and saved remote credentials（XL）。吸引了 10+ 后续 issue（#12330–#12340）——证明了对无摩擦远程 onboarding 的高兴趣，但也反映了审查负担：PR head 存在已知粗糙边缘（ledger actor 双前缀、smoke-test 顺序、cert-without-CA 语义、凭证修剪）。
  3. PR #11847 — 原生 Rust XMPP，可选 OMEMO（XL，高风险）及配套 #12015（ChaCha20Poly1305 统一）和 #12319（重复 crate 允许列表）。社区推动渠道广度；这是最大的开放功能列车之一。
  4. PR #12244 — 通过核心 RPC 的范围化仪表盘聊天（XL，do-not-merge，已阻塞）。长期运行的核心架构 PR。

底层需求：(a) 畅通的发布流水线，(b) 更低摩擦的远程登录，(c) 更广泛/更现代的渠道支持，(d) 整合重复的加密/依赖面。

5. Bug 与稳定性

按严重程度排序（除非注明，均为 2026-11-09 提交/更新）：

  • S1 / 工作流阻塞： #12320 — RUSTSEC-2026-0459 在每次构建中导致 Security 任务失败；合并队列和发布陷入死锁。尚无修复 PR。
  • S0 安全（针对开放 PR head 的审查发现；修复 = 合并前修订 PR）：
    • #12311 — macOS Seatbelt 配置文件授予沙箱命令读取所有 home dotfiles（包括 ~/.zeroclaw）的权限（PR #12150）。
    • #12310 — MCP 配置控制桥接授予模型无限制的配置写入权限，且无审批（PR #12275）。
    • #12309 — sessions_prompt 目标范围未强制执行；PR head 无法编译（PR #12258）。
    • #12308 — 会话删除/TTL 后转录和载荷仍可读；无擦除路径。
    • #12307 — 网关会话丢失 gw_ 命名空间 → 对等调用者可跨会话附加。
    • #12306 — Matrix Goal 父轮次绕过 effort_routing 允许列表（cloud_escalation = never）。
    • #12305 — 守护进程级成本限制覆盖可由非 Telegram 渠道上的任何允许列表对等方批准。
    • #12304 — colony 渠道回复将操作员消息泄露给外部成员（PR #11560）。
  • S2： #12330 — 当 zerocode-config.toml 不可读/不可解析时，zerocode 静默回退到本地守护进程（存在错误端点连接风险）；#12325 — 文档规范 URL 指向发布目录，因此每次发布都会重排 SEO URL。
  • S3： #12347 — zerocode 配置写入者可能丢失并发更新（读-改-写，无锁）；#12326 和 #12324 — 已修剪版本和可索引的 rustdoc/404 页面出现文档 404。

6. 功能请求与路线图信号

  • 无需配对仪式的远程访问 — #12317 的 OIDC 自助设备证书引导，按 #12337 由操作员 opt-in 门控。一旦 #12320 清除，是 v0.9.0 的有力候选。
  • 渠道广度与安全 — XMPP/OMEMO（#11847）、未授权入站消息的所有者通知（PR #12346）、Matrix 路由加固（#12306）。
  • 迁移/互操作 — OpenClaw 导入（#12348，已关闭）。
  • Web UX — 配对设备的语音设置（PR #12269）、折叠 Thinking 开关（#11919，已完成）、窄布局修复（#11933，已完成）。
  • 凭证卫生 — 修剪被取代的 OIDC 凭证代次（#12339）并定义 cert-without-CA 语义（#12338）。

预测：下一个版本将以安全加固（沙箱、会话隔离、审批路径）、zerocode OIDC onboarding 和渠道工作为主——完全取决于 #12320。

7. 用户反馈摘要

  • 挫败感： 发布/CI 阻塞（#12320）是最响亮的信号——什么都无法落地；贡献者产出了经过验证的修复却无处合并。
  • 安全敏感用户（自托管/守护进程操作员）提出了具体的隔离关切：沙箱文件访问、跨会话附加、群聊审批滥用和消息泄露。这些读起来是真实的部署痛点，而非理论问题。
  • 移动/Web 用户： 对响应式和 UX 修复（#11933、#11920）表示满意，表明仪表盘在手机上有活跃使用。
  • Onboarding 摩擦： zerocode 用户希望无配对登录，并愿意接受 opt-in 默认值（#12337）；后续 issue 的数量表明该功能被需要，但当前 head 尚未达到生产就绪。
  • 静默失败焦虑： #12330（配置解析失败 → 本地守护进程回退）和 #12347（丢失配置写入）是那种侵蚀 TUI 客户端信任的微妙降级。

8. 待办关注

  • PR #11868（自 2026-10-19 开放，needs-maintainer-review）— 调度前的重复调用抑制；阻塞相关 #11911，并有配套文档 PR #12265 等待处理。
  • PR #11317（自 2026-10-01 开放，XS 文档）— 有界插件 webhook RPC 放置例外；一个月前的一行文档 PR 仍未审查。
  • PR #11847（自 2026-10-19 开放，XL，needs-maintainer-review）— XMPP 渠道列车；需要审查带宽以避免相对 master 的位腐。
  • PR #12244（已阻塞，do-not-merge）— 通过核心 RPC 的仪表盘聊天；高风险且长期存在，面临冲突搅动风险。
  • Issue #12320 — 不算旧，但最紧迫：它是阻塞整个合并队列和下一发布的基石。

所有链接引用 github.com/zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw。数据快照：2026-11-09/10 活动窗口。

本日报由 agents-radar 自动生成。

item.content:encoded:
OpenClaw Ecosystem Digest 2026-11-10

Issues: 500 | PRs: 500 | Projects covered: 5 | Generated: 2026-11-09 23:19 UTC

  • OpenClaw
  • Hermes Agent
  • IronClaw
  • QwenPaw
  • ZeroClaw

OpenClaw Deep Dive

OpenClaw Project Digest — 2026-11-10

1. Today's Overview

OpenClaw remains in a high-velocity maintenance phase with no new releases in the last 24 hours, but substantial triage and engineering throughput: 500 issues and 500 PRs were touched, with 208 issues closed and 131 PRs merged/closed. The open backlog skews toward stability work — crash-loop/restart reliability, SQLite/session-state integrity, and Windows/Kubernetes deployment failures dominate the top-commented issues. PR activity is concentrated in small, surgical fixes (CLI error surfacing, WebChat rendering, Android/Telegram channel behavior) rather than large features. Overall health is moderate-to-good: strong maintainer responsiveness and many "ready for maintainer look" PRs, but a persistent cluster of P0/P1 reliability defects (Windows startup, update-after-crash paths, session wedging) suggests the update/restart subsystem is the project's current weak point.

2. Releases

None. No new releases or pre-releases were published in the last 24 hours.

3. Project Progress

131 PRs were merged/closed. Notable closed items signaling forward movement:

  • Issue #172628 [CLOSED, P1] — Fresh Gateway start leaving main-agent admission superseded until restart (fix-shape clear, queueable). Link
  • Issue #167506 [CLOSED, P0] — Deleted temporary handoff DB blocking package recovery and future updates. Link
  • Issue #192959 [CLOSED, P1] — Kubernetes fsGroup remount causing credential-directory rejection. Link
  • Issue #175926 / #158966 / #168794 [CLOSED] — SQLite snapshot reclamation, CDP credential leak, and Codex relay 502 issues respectively.
  • PR #196294 [CLOSED] — Knowledge memory save latency on large vaults (~11s → ~2s). Link

Progress is incremental: many closures appear to be stale-bot or resolution triage rather than shipped fixes (several closed items carry stale labels and no linked fix PR), so "closed" should not be read uniformly as "fixed."

4. Community Hot Topics

Rank Item Comments Signal
1 #170956 Windows slow startup / unclean plugin shutdown / schtasks permission error 30 P0, UX release-blocker
2 #166634 SQLite session reclamation checkpoint failure → agent unavailable after crash 27 Session-state
3 #193962 Header-probe timeout fix unreachable via openclaw update from 2026.10.10 21 P0, diamond lobster
4 #166133 MCP integer args coerced to string 16 P2, needs product decision
5 #164394 WebChat transcript jitter (now CLOSED) 15 UX friction
6 #144336 Deferred config-reload restart fails shutdown step 14 P1, crash-loop

Underlying needs: The top threads cluster around a single theme — trustworthy restarts and updates. Users cannot reliably recover from crashes or apply fixes, which both blocks adoption and turns transient bugs into permanent outages. The second theme is session durability: reclamation/lock/checkpoint failures strand agents until manual intervention. The MCP coercion thread reflects growing third-party-integration demand and the need for a product decision on the tool-call adapter.

5. Bugs & Stability

Ranked by severity (open items today):

P0 / release-blocking

  • #170956 — Windows: slow startup, unclean plugin shutdown, schtasks permission error; restarts/updates unreliable. No fix PR linked.
  • #193962 — Fix for SQLite header-probe timeout unreachable on affected installs because package-update runs the installed updater's 10s probe. Source-repro. No fix PR linked.

P1 / crash-loop, data-loss, session-state

  • #144336 — Deferred SIGUSR1 restart fails shutdown ("singleton lifecycle state lost"). Needs live repro.
  • #157255 — Turn claim not released after lane timeout; 90+ min session wedge.
  • #190307 — Gateway restart leaves many agents permanently degraded (admission timeout).
  • #174895 — Live Gateway state owner judged stale; lock reclaimed by second process. Windows.
  • #166641 — web_fetch cold fallback synchronously loads plugins on main thread → liveness stall.
  • #191841 — 2026.10.10 regression: native child reaping unavailable on glibc < 2.31 (RHEL 8/al8); all exec fails.
  • #167472 — Subagent exec approvals fail (missing scope: operator.approvals), fail-closed, no approval card.
  • #192141 — Interrupted-turn continuation drops original user text.

P2 / notable

  • #182891 — Prompt cache never reused (cache read dropped N -> 0).
  • #176187 — Sparse vec0 allocation pushes memory_search past 30s deadline.
  • #194662 — Notification wake invents a sender; main session keeps phantom thread alive.

Assessment: Several of the highest-severity issues have no linked fix PR and require live repro or product decisions, indicating a support bottleneck rather than an engineering one. Notably, #193962 is a meta-bug: the recovery path for a prior fix is itself broken, which is the most dangerous pattern in the set.

6. Feature Requests & Roadmap Signals

  • CJK/Chinese search support — #170997 requests a bigram FTS tokenizer (trigram cannot match 2-char queries; unicode61 doesn't segment CJK). Companion issue #173839 on CJK payload prechecks suggests a coherent i18n/APAC push.
  • Rendered Markdown preview in Review files — #128090, 4 👍, fix-shape clear. Low-risk, likely candidate.
  • Android parity — #175826 design-acceptance request for in-chat questions/approvals; PR activity (#195979, #195928, #196300) confirms active Android investment.
  • Per-automation web-search provider — #173518 (closed, product decision pending).
  • Operator recovery tooling — #170562 for stranded requester settle wakes; #165685 machine-readable collector reasons.

Prediction: Near-term releases will likely prioritize (a) CJK search/tokenizer work, (b) Android feature parity, and (c) small Control UI/WebChat polish PRs. Memory/REM exclusion semantics (#172547) is a plausible medium-term item.

7. User Feedback Summary

Pain points

  • Update/restart reliability is the dominant frustration — users describe requiring "many retries" and hours-long misdiagnoses. #173313 (config get masking sensitive values) reportedly caused a 4+ hour outage verification loop during a Funnel recovery.
  • Silent degradation: sessions wedge for 90+ minutes; agents become "degraded" after restart; crash recovery leaves agents permanently refusing chat.history/models.list.
  • Diagnostic traps: status --deep and status --agent swallow real errors (addressed by PRs #196073, #196081); gateway restart reports failure yet exits 0 (#161158).
  • Deployment friction on Windows (schtasks), Kubernetes (fsGroup), and RHEL 8 (glibc).

Positive signals

  • Maintainers are visibly engaging on high-severity threads (30/27/21 comments), and many PRs are tagged "ready for maintainer look" or carry screenshot/proof evidence.
  • Users file detailed, high-quality reproductions with environment and version data, suggesting a technically invested user base.

Sentiment: Frustrated but engaged. Satisfaction hinges on restart/update reliability; there is clear appetite for fixing the operational substrate before adding features.

8. Backlog Watch

Long-unanswered or decision-blocked items needing maintainer attention:

Item Age Blocker
#92473 Model fallback notice leaks to user-facing channels ~5 months needs-product-decision
#91931 Preseeded identity files auto-complete bootstrap, delete user BOOTSTRAP.md ~5 months P1, data-loss, needs product decision; fix PR #196302 now open
#137613 Pre-compaction memory flush disabled on CLI backends ~2 months Product decision
#166133 MCP integer→string coercion ~1 month Product decision, 16 comments
#128090 Markdown preview in Review ~2.5 months Fix-shape clear, awaiting maintainer
#173057 Shared agents.defaults.workspace treated as live workspace ~1 month Needs live repro
#151923 Telegram large-media 30s timeout (PR) ~2 months Waiting on maintainer
#178677 Cron jobs blocked on missing creator channel (PR) ~3 weeks Waiting on author, security review required

Priority recommendation: #193962 and #170956 warrant immediate maintainer ownership — they are P0 recovery-path failures with no fix PRs and directly compound user dissatisfaction with updates. #91931 is notable because a fix PR now exists after five months; fast-tracking it would close a long-standing data-loss complaint.

Data source: github.com/openclaw/openclaw, 24h window ending 2026-11-09. Comment/reaction counts reflect items updated in that period; "no fix PR linked" references the clawsweeper:no-new-fix-pr label where present.

Cross-Ecosystem Comparison

Cross-Project Comparison Report — Personal AI Assistant / Agent OSS Ecosystem

Snapshot date: 2026-11-10 | Projects: OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, IronClaw, QwenPaw, ZeroClaw

1. Ecosystem Overview

The personal AI assistant open-source landscape is bifurcating into two camps: mature "Claw-family" runtimes (OpenClaw as reference implementation, plus derivatives Hermes, ZeroClaw, IronClaw) built around agent runtimes, messaging gateways, and plugin ecosystems — and application-layer assistants (QwenPaw) focused on local model runtimes and console UX. The dominant engineering burden across the ecosystem has shifted from feature acquisition to operational reliability: crash recovery, restart/update paths, session-state durability, and security isolation now consume the majority of maintainer attention. Security review is maturing rapidly — ZeroClaw shows a formal S0-severity review pipeline against every open PR, and Hermes/OpenClaw both closed security-boundary bugs this cycle. Local-first inference (MLX, llama.cpp, Ollama) and plugin/marketplace distribution are the two clearest greenfield vectors, while Windows remains the ecosystem's most fragile platform.

3. OpenClaw's Position

Advantages vs. peers

  • Scale of surface area: 500 issues + 500 PRs touched in 24h vs. 50/50 for Hermes and ZeroClaw. This produces the fastest discovery-to-fix loop in the ecosystem — e.g., PR #196294 cutting knowledge-memory save latency from ~11s to ~2s.
  • Ecosystem gravity: ZeroClaw ships an explicit zeroclaw migrate openclaw-config importer (#12348), and Hermes/ZeroClaw both inherit Claw-family architectural assumptions. OpenClaw is the de facto config and concept standard.
  • Breadth of integrations: Control UI, WebChat, Android, Telegram, Kubernetes, MCP, SQLite-backed memory/search — no peer matches this integration matrix in a single repo.

Technical approach differences

  • SQLite-centric state model (session reclamation, checkpointing, vec0 memory search) — this is OpenClaw's signature bet and also its signature liability (see the P0 session-wedge cluster). Peers like Hermes lean on a REST session API (/api/sessions) and QwenPaw on a local runtime stack.
  • Update/restart subsystem as first-class concern — no peer exposes as much operational tooling (status --deep, gateway restart, openclaw update), and none has as many bugs in it. The #193962 "meta-bug" (the fix for a prior fix is unreachable via the updater) is uniquely an OpenClaw-scale problem.

Community size comparison

  • Issue engagement confirms a larger, more technically invested user base: top threads carry 30/27/21 comments with detailed environment reproductions, versus Hermes' 11/10/9 and QwenPaw's 4-comment ceiling. OpenClaw's users are operating it in production (K8s, RHEL 8, Windows enterprise) — a maturity signal peers have not yet reached.

Cross-cutting insight: Four of five active projects independently hit the same class of bug — a recovery or continuation path that silently loses data. This is an ecosystem-wide architectural gap, not a per-project defect.

Notable divergence: ZeroClaw is the only project treating security review as a pre-merge gate producing S0 findings — a materially different engineering culture from OpenClaw's triage-driven model. QwenPaw is the only project investing in first-party local inference, which positions it against OpenClaw's cloud-adapter assumptions.

6. Community Momentum & Maturity

Activity tiers

  • Tier 1 — Ecosystem anchor: OpenClaw (500/500, triage-dominant). Mature but carrying operational debt.
  • Tier 2 — Converging stabilizers: Hermes (32 issue closures, Telegram sweep, 14 merges) and QwenPaw (release-shipping beta cycle, 9 merges, 3 first-time contributors). Both are closing faster than they open.
  • Tier 3 — Blocked/dormant: ZeroClaw (contributor output high, merge queue dead — momentum is real but unrealizable) and IronClaw (no activity; likely dormant or pre-launch).

Iterating vs. stabilizing

  • Rapidly iterating: QwenPaw (new MLX/GPU runtime stack in flight, UX polish PRs same-day) and Hermes (plugin catalog expansion — 4 submissions in one day).
  • Stabilizing under load: OpenClaw and Hermes are both in hardening phases — OpenClaw on restarts/sessions, Hermes on Telegram correctness. Neither is adding major features.
  • Stalled: ZeroClaw needs a single dependency decision (#12320) to convert a large backlog of verified fixes into releases. This is the highest-leverage unblock in the ecosystem.

Maturity ranking (composite): OpenClaw > Hermes ≈ QwenPaw > ZeroClaw >> IronClaw. Notably, QwenPaw's release-gating discipline (auto-opened 4-hour cross-platform verification issue #8643) is more mature than its bug volume suggests.

7. Trend Signals (for AI agent developers)

  1. Reliability is the new feature. Across OpenClaw, Hermes, and QwenPaw, users explicitly prioritize delivery guarantees over new capabilities — silent message loss, stale-stop dropping turns, and post-crash wedges are the loudest complaints. Action: design idempotent continuation and explicit "message settled" acknowledgements into any agent loop.
  2. Recovery-path regressions are the most dangerous bug class. OpenClaw's #193962 (fix unreachable via the updater) and ZeroClaw's #12330 (silent local-daemon fallback) show that the path back to health is under-tested. Action: test the updater with the updater; treat failover as a first-class state machine, not a catch block.
  3. Security review is shifting left, pre-merge. ZeroClaw's S0 findings against open PR heads (sandbox dotfile access, approval-scope bypass, cross-session attach) set a new bar. Action: require approval binding to the requesting identity and sandbox-scoped file access by default.
  4. Local-first inference is arriving in the assistant layer. QwenPaw's MLX/llama.cpp/GPU-control stack and Ollama num_ctx fix signal that desktop assistants will own their inference runtime. Action: abstract model backends early; do not hard-code cloud adapter assumptions.
  5. Platform parity is a trust issue, not a nicety. Windows (schtasks, long paths, GBK), RHEL 8 (glibc), iPhone Safari (requestIdleCallback), and Linux translucency all generate outsized frustration. Action: treat non-default locale/encoding and frozen-build environments as tier-1 test targets.
  6. Ecosystem interop is consolidating around OpenClaw conventions. ZeroClaw's migration importer and shared Claw-family config concepts suggest a de facto standard is forming. Action: for new entrants, align config/session semantics with OpenClaw to inherit tooling and migrate-in paths.
  7. Plugin marketplaces are the next reliability frontier. Install-path failures (#8595), frozen-build activation regressions (#8644), and framework-managed lifecycle PRs (#8431) all point the same way. Action: design plugin dependency verification and lifecycle management before scaling a catalog.

Bottom line for decision-makers: OpenClaw is the ecosystem's reference implementation and should be tracked as the compatibility baseline; Hermes and QwenPaw are the healthiest active bets for messaging-gateway and desktop/local-runtime use cases respectively; ZeroClaw carries the strongest security posture but needs its CI gate resolved before it can ship; IronClaw shows no signal this cycle. The defining 2026 engineering problem is operational trust — restarts, recovery, and delivery guarantees — not feature breadth.

1. Today's Overview

ZeroClaw is in a blocked-release state: Issue #12320 reports that RUSTSEC-2026-0459 (libsqlite3-sys 0.38.2 / bundled SQLite 3.53.2) fails the Security job on every CI run, which cascades into CI Required Gate failure — meaning no PR can merge and the merge queue is stalled. Activity remains high (35 issues and 50 PRs touched in 24h) but is heavily skewed toward review findings: a single reviewer (IftekharUddin) filed a batch of S0 security findings against open PR heads (#12304–#12312, #12305, #12306, #12309, #12310, #12311) and tidux landed a large zerocode OIDC login PR (#12317) with a cluster of follow-up issues (#12331–#12340). No releases were cut, consistent with the blocked gate. Net assessment: healthy contributor throughput, degraded merge health due to a CI blocker plus several critical pre-merge security findings.

2. Releases

None in this window. Note for planning: all release-tagged work is currently gated behind #12320.

3. Project Progress

Merged/closed PRs today:

  • #12348 (closed, XL) — feat(migrate): import OpenClaw config, agents, and workspaces: adds zeroclaw migrate openclaw-config, mapping providers, fallback chains, and agents (balanced risk preset). Significant ecosystem-interop feature.
  • #11933 (closed, XS) — fix(web): keep the chat header on screen in narrow layouts: responsive fix for mobile chat.
  • #11920 (closed, XS) — feat(web): toggle to keep the live Thinking box collapsed (closes #11919): UX improvement for reasoning models.
  • #12342 (closed, XS) — docs: bounded runtime placement exception for zerocode OIDC (#12317), unblocking that feature's merge contract.

Closed issues: #10359 (audit-log hash-chain poisoning — pre-existing, now closed), #11009 (alias rename not cascading permission profiles), #12064 (Discord peer-bot approval bypass), #12087 (tool toggle double-save), #11952 (--prefixed relative data dir), #12312 (OIDC discovery endpoint policy gap), #11919 (Thinking box).

4. Community Hot Topics

  1. Issue #12320 — CI security gate failure (S1, 3 comments). The single highest-leverage thread: every release and merge depends on resolving the RUSTSEC advisory. Needs either a dependency bump or a scoped, documented advisory exception.
  2. PR #12317 — feat(zerocode): pairing-free OIDC login and saved remote credentials (XL). Attracted 10+ follow-up issues (#12330–#12340) — proof of high interest in frictionless remote onboarding, but also of review load: the PR head has known rough edges (ledger actor double-prefix, smoke-test ordering, cert-without-CA semantics, credential pruning).
  3. PR #11847 — native Rust XMPP with optional OMEMO (XL, high risk) and companion #12015 (ChaCha20Poly1305 unification) and #12319 (duplicate-crate allowances). Community push for channel breadth; this is one of the largest open feature trains.
  4. PR #12244 — scoped dashboard chat through core RPC (XL, do-not-merge, blocked). Long-running core architecture PR.

Underlying needs: (a) an unblocked release pipeline, (b) lower-friction remote login, (c) broader/more modern channel support, (d) consolidation of duplicated crypto/dependency surfaces.

5. Bugs & Stability

Ranked by severity (all filed/updated 2026-11-09 unless noted):

  • S1 / workflow-blocking: #12320 — RUSTSEC-2026-0459 fails Security job on every build; merge queue and release are deadlocked. No fix PR yet.
  • S0 security (review findings against open PR heads; fix = revise the PR before merge):
    • #12311 — macOS Seatbelt profile grants sandboxed commands read access to all home dotfiles incl. ~/.zeroclaw (PR #12150).
    • #12310 — MCP config-control bridge grants model unrestricted config writes with no approval (PR #12275).
    • #12309 — sessions_prompt target scoping unenforced; PR head doesn't compile (PR #12258).
    • #12308 — session delete/TTL leaves transcripts and payloads readable; no erasure path.
    • #12307 — gateway sessions lose gw_ namespace → cross-session attach by paired callers.
    • #12306 — Matrix Goal parent turns bypass effort_routing allowlist (cloud_escalation = never).
    • #12305 — daemon-wide cost-limit override approvable by any allowlisted peer on non-Telegram channels.
    • #12304 — colony channel replies leak operator messages to external members (PR #11560).
  • S2: #12330 — zerocode silently falls back to local daemon when zerocode-config.toml is unreadable/unparseable (risk of wrong-endpoint connections); #12325 — docs canonical URLs point at a release dir, so every release reshuffles SEO URLs.
  • S3: #12347 — zerocode config writers can lose concurrent updates (read-modify-write, no lock); #12326 and #12324 — docs 404s for pruned versions and indexable rustdoc/404 pages.

6. Feature Requests & Roadmap Signals

  • Remote access without pairing ceremony — #12317's OIDC self-service device certificate bootstrap, gated behind operator opt-in per #12337. Strong candidate for v0.9.0 once #12320 clears.
  • Channel breadth & security — XMPP/OMEMO (#11847), owner notifications for unauthorized inbound messages (PR #12346), Matrix routing hardening (#12306).
  • Migration/interop — OpenClaw import (#12348, already closed).
  • Web UX — voice settings for paired devices (PR #12269), collapsed Thinking toggle (#11919, done), narrow-layout fixes (#11933, done).
  • Credential hygiene — pruning superseded OIDC credential generations (#12339) and defining cert-without-CA semantics (#12338).

Prediction: next release will be dominated by security hardening (sandbox, session isolation, approval paths), zerocode OIDC onboarding, and channel work — contingent entirely on #12320.

7. User Feedback Summary

  • Frustration: release/CI blockage (#12320) is the loudest signal — nothing can land; contributors are producing verified fixes with nowhere to merge.
  • Security-sensitive users (self-hosted/daemon operators) are surfacing concrete isolation concerns: sandbox file access, cross-session attach, group-chat approval abuse, and message leakage. These read as real deployment pain, not theoretical.
  • Mobile/web users: satisfied with responsive and UX fixes (#11933, #11920), indicating active dashboard usage on phones.
  • Onboarding friction: zerocode users want pairing-free login and are willing to accept opt-in defaults (#12337); the volume of follow-ups shows the feature is wanted but the current head is not production-ready.
  • Silent-failure anxiety: #12330 (config parse failure → local daemon fallback) and #12347 (lost config writes) are the kind of subtle degradations that erode trust in the TUI client.

8. Backlog Watch

  • PR #11868 (open since 2026-10-19, needs-maintainer-review) — repeated-call suppression before dispatch; blocks related #11911 and has companion docs PR #12265 awaiting action.
  • PR #11317 (open since 2026-10-01, XS docs) — bounded plugin webhook RPC placement exception; a month-old one-row docs PR still unreviewed.
  • PR #11847 (open since 2026-10-19, XL, needs-maintainer-review) — XMPP channel train; needs review bandwidth to avoid bit-rot against master.
  • PR #12244 (blocked, do-not-merge) — dashboard chat via core RPC; high risk and long-lived, at risk of conflict churn.
  • Issue #12320 — not old, but the most urgent: it is the keystone blocking the entire merge queue and next release.

All links reference github.com/zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw. Data snapshot: 2026-11-09/10 activity window.

item.content:encoded:
AI 基础设施日报 2026-11-10

生成时间: 2026-11-09 23:19 UTC | 覆盖项目: 6 个

  • vLLM
  • SGLang
  • llama.cpp
  • Ollama
  • LiteLLM
  • Unsloth

横向对比

跨项目对比报告 — AI 基础设施生态

摘要日期：2026-11-10

1. 生态概览

今日的动态印证了一个双层基础设施格局：服务引擎（vLLM、SGLang）正处于硬件适配的堑壕战之中——SM120/GB10 消费级 Blackwell 与 MI355X/MI450 如今消耗了大部分 issue 和 PR 带宽，且正确性回归（静默空补全、内核输出静默损坏）的数量已超过功能开发。本地/边缘层（llama.cpp、Ollama、Unsloth） 迭代速度很快，但正沿后端（Metal、Vulkan、SYCL、ROCm、OpenCL、XDNA）走向碎片化，可复现性与 KV 缓存正确性成为反复出现的薄弱环节。网关层（LiteLLM） 正围绕计量正确性进行整合——一批已关闭的预算/限流绕过缺陷，加上原生 Rust 后端的 /v1/messages 路径，表明计费准确性已成为主要竞争轴。在所有层级中，投机解码正成熟为默认的吞吐量杠杆，同时也在产生最大的一簇正确性回归（EAGLE/MTP/DFlash/DFlash2/DSpine 分歧、TP>1 时接受率崩塌）。值得注意的是：过去 24 小时内 vLLM、SGLang 或 Unsloth 均无发布——今日的工作是集成与缺陷修复，而非发版。

2. 活跃度对比

项目 层级 涉及 Issue 数 涉及 PR 数 发布状态（24 小时） 主导主题
vLLM 服务引擎 ~14（6 个 issue + 8 个回归项） ~10 无 Blackwell（SM120）就绪度缺口；Marlin→Humming 迁移；投机解码正确性
SGLang 服务引擎 ~13 ~13 无（标记 v0.5.22→v0.5.23 回归） CI 不稳定；SM120 覆盖；AMD MI355X/MI450 内核工作
llama.cpp 本地运行时 ~18 ~18 有 — 18 个构建（b12219–b12236） 后端正确性（Metal FA 越界）；音频重采样；JSON-schema 服务端修复
Ollama 本地运行时 ~10 ~7 有 — v0.40.16-rc0 OpenAI 兼容面；VRAM 核算/GPU 拆分修复（#19632）
LiteLLM 网关 ~20 ~10 有 — v1.108.4（cosign 签名镜像） 成本/预算核算正确性；原生 /v1/messages Rust 路径
Unsloth 微调 + 本地服务 ~12 ~10 无（typer 0.29 Windows 故障已锁定版本） 解码 CUDA 图（T4 上 2–8×）；Studio OpenAI 兼容网关缺陷

发布节奏解读： llama.cpp 是唯一持续发版的项目（每天 18 个构建）。LiteLLM 以约每周一次的节奏发版，并已预告 2.0.0 破坏性变更。vLLM/SGLang/Unsloth 正处于功能稳定化的间歇期——这一模式与发布前加固周期一致，也是对锁定“最新版”的消费者而言风险最高的窗口。

3. 模型支持竞赛

模型 / 架构 vLLM SGLang llama.cpp Ollama LiteLLM Unsloth
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ⚠️ SM120 CUDA 图损坏（#56892） ⚠️ SM90 解码回归 v0.5.23（#49336） — — — —
Kimi K3.1 ✅ PR #66532（NVIDIA 解码 + ROCm TP8） ✅ MI355X 上 K3 的 AITER MoE 排序（#43126） ✅ 视觉（#31980） — — —
Qwen3.8 / 3.5 / 3.6 ⚠️ Flash-Next 长上下文缺陷（#62776）；drafter 阻塞项（#56088） ⚠️ GDN prefill PR（#38806、#48398） — ✅ 并行请求解锁 PR #17144（3.5/MoE） ✅ 自定义部署的 tokenizer 修复（#50734） ✅ Qwen3.5/3.6 + GDN 混合解码图（#17324、#17329）
Gemma 4 — — ✅ 音频流式（余弦 0.993–0.997 对比非流式） — — ✅ 解码图（#17329）
MiniMax M3 / H3 ✅ MSA 索引器 CP（#61929） ✅ H3 的 FP8 视频 VAE（#45180） — — — —
Claude 5.x / Fable 5.2 — — — — ✅ Vertex + Bedrock Converse 支持（#50742）；prefill-400 修复 PR #50701 —
GLM-5.x / 5.3-Flash — ⚠️ SM120 fa4 崩溃（#42012） — — ⚠️ glm-5.2[1m] 未知模型（#32218） ✅ 解码图（GLM-4 系列）
DFlash / DSpine drafters ⚠️ TP>1 时崩塌（#66387） ✅ DSpark KV 写入修复（#49386） ✅ DFLASH2（#31904）、腾讯 DSpine（#31941） — — —
Nemotron-H / 3.5 ASR ✅ 弹性宽度（#66665）；ASR 请求开放中 — — — — —
Granite — — ✅ NVFP4 缩放（b12223） — — ✅ 解码图

谁领先： vLLM 在广度上领先（Kimi K3.1、MiniMax M3、Nemotron-H、DeepSeek-V4.1），但在新硬件上承载了最多的模型专属回归。llama.cpp 在长尾架构支持上领先（Gemma 4 音频、DFLASH2/DSpine、Granite NVFP4），并且是新 drafter 格式事实上的参考实现。Unsloth 在 Qwen3.5/3.6 与 Gemma 4 推理加速 上意外位居第二，正从训练侧向服务引擎的领地渗透。LiteLLM 是唯一在添加云厂商模型对齐（Fable 5.2 于 Vertex/Bedrock）的项目——它的竞赛发生在 API 形态层，而非内核层。Ollama 的新模型覆盖面最窄，且仍受制于 Qwen3.5 MoE 并行（numParallel=1）。

4. 性能前沿

优化领域 vLLM SGLang llama.cpp Ollama LiteLLM Unsloth
KV 缓存 FlashInfer 工作区收缩 → KV 容量 +21%（#63399）；KV 卸载 DMA 阈值（#57555）；饱和准入下 TPOT 膨胀（#64460） Supernode L1+L2 KV 共享路线图（#43098）；prompt 缓存恢复正确性 可增长 KV 可选项（UNSLOTH_GROWABLE_KV=1）避免 StaticCache 过度分配 ⚠️ Vulkan prompt 缓存第 2 次请求约 30× 减速（#19201，已关闭） 缓存读取计费修复（#37823） 可增长 KV 缓存（可选项）
批处理 / 调度 HiSparse 协调器批处理消除数十毫秒停顿（#65607）；准入控制 PP 调度器陈旧 DSpark 修复（#49386）；Agentic 缓存调度路线图 — sched.go 为 Qwen3.5-MoE 解锁 numParallel=1（#17144） 高吞吐下 Redis 计数器无效写入（#31880） —
量化 Marlin→Humming 迁移（#65560）；NVFP4 MoE 静默失败（#51525）；AutoAWQ 在 RDNA 上慢 2.5×（#63455） NPU 上的 MXFP4 注意力（#43367） NVFP4 Granite 缩放（b12223）；OpenCL int8 融合 KQ（#30249） — — —
分布式服务 TP-rank 自动调优同步标志（#66526）；Kimi K3.1 ROCm TP8 MI450 的 Ring all-reduce + 2shot_push（#49377）；DCP 索引器行拆分（#47309） — 多 GPU 拆分核算修复（#19632） 放弃流的原生 /v1/messages 计费（#50425） —
内核 Triton 自动调优确定性；Eager 注意力视图重新推导（#64572） 单遍 Triton/Gluon DSA top-k 在 MI355X 上 1.5–1.9×（#47872）；AITER 汇编稀疏 MLA Metal FA 越界写入已修补（b12221）；x86 BF16 点积（#31878）；ARM NEON IQ4_NL 重打包（#30165） — — —
解码加速 目标 logits 上的投机解码 top-k/top-p（#66534） EAGLE 逐 draft 位置重复惩罚修复（#49404） Adreno Vulkan 标量 FA 上限（#30829）；MMVQ 截断表（#28090） — — T4 上 CUDA 图 2–8×（#16587），模型专属扩展

集中度解读： 可见三场不同的战役。(a) AMD 已成为一等性能目标——SGLang 拥有最深的 MI355X/MI450 内核流水线（DSA top-k、ring all-reduce、AITER 汇编 MLA）；vLLM 正以 ROCm AITER MLA 追赶（但遭遇了一个已关闭的严重静默损坏缺陷 #66141）。(b) KV 缓存容量是普遍瓶颈——vLLM 通过工作区调优回收，Unsloth 通过可增长分配，SGLang 通过 supernode 共享；Ollama 的 Vulkan prompt 缓存 30× 回归是警示性的反例。(c) 解码图正从训练框架向外扩散——Unsloth 默认开启的 CUDA 图在 T4 上带来 2–8×，是本摘要集中最大的头条吞吐量声明，且它直接与服务引擎争夺“小模型、高吞吐”用例。

5. 层级定位

层级 项目 核心功能 本周战略信号
服务引擎（数据中心） vLLM、SGLang 高吞吐、多 GPU、PagedAttention 级服务；分离式 prefill/decode（PD）、TP/PP/DP 两者均受制于硬件适配：SM120/GB10 与 MI 侧缺口占主导。功能迭代速度是后端 bring-up 的下游。差异化正转向正确性保障（确定性标志、消除静默失败），而非原始吞吐量。
本地 / 边缘运行时 llama.cpp、Ollama 单节点/消费级服务、GGUF 量化、多后端可移植性（Metal/CUDA/Vulkan/SYCL/OpenCL/NPU） llama.cpp 是后端可移植性领先者但正碎片化（每天 18 个构建横跨 10 个后端）；Ollama 是整合者/分发层，押注 OpenAI 兼容与 Docker 捆绑的 MLX/Vulkan。两者均面临 KV 缓存正确性债务（#11970、#30961）。
网关 / 控制平面 LiteLLM 路由、限流、预算、成本核算、提供商归一化、PII 护栏 网关正成为计量与策略执行点——本周的 issue 簇（5 个高危预算/限流绕过，均已关闭）证明该层仍在加固。原生 Rust /v1/messages（7 个 PR 的栈）是热路径的基础设施语言迁移。
微调 → 服务桥梁 Unsloth SFT/RL 微调，随后通过 FastModel.generate() 与 Studio 进行本地服务 Unsloth 正纵向向上整合：解码 CUDA 图、可增长 KV、OpenAI 兼容的 Studio 网关。对于 Qwen/Llama/Gemma 级工作负载，它如今已是可信的单机服务引擎替代方案。训练侧正确性（CPU 评估损失 #17291）是当前的缺口。

采购视角： vLLM/SGLang = 横向扩展的多租户服务；llama.cpp = 最大硬件可移植性与模型广度；Ollama = 开发者体验与分发；LiteLLM = 多提供商治理与成本控制；Unsloth = 一站式微调后服务。这些互补而非可替代——有意思的重叠在于 Unsloth 对本地服务引擎，以及 LiteLLM 对原生提供商 SDK。

6. 趋势信号

1. 静默正确性失败是新的可用性风险。 本周两个 CRITICAL 级 issue 返回HTTP 200 但内容错误：vLLM 的 NVFP4 MoE 在 SM120 上空补全（#51525，content: null + finish_reason: length）以及已关闭但待验证的 ROCm AITER MLA 不相关输出（#66141）。结合 llama.cpp 的投机解码 temp-0 分歧（#31472）与 SGLang 可破坏的 prefill CUDA 图分歧（#49133），信息很明确：输出校验必须成为服务栈的一部分，而不是应用的假设。

2. 投机解码既是吞吐量默认项，也是正确性前沿。 今天每个项目都触及了它——vLLM（EAGLE/MTP 前缀缓存块丢弃，30–40% 批损失；DFlash TP>1 崩塌）、SGLang（EAGLE 重复惩罚偏斜修复）、llama.cpp（DFLASH2/DSpine、temp-0 分歧）、Unsloth（解码图）。运行对可复现性敏感的评估或确定性 agent 的开发者应禁用投机解码或锁定版本，直到各项目的修复矩阵落地。

3. AMD 不再是次要目标——它是共同一等公民。 SGLang 有密集的 MI355X/MI450 PR 流；vLLM 有 MI355X 性能追踪器与“MonoKernel”提案（#60904）；llama.cpp 与 Ollama 承载着持续的 ROCm/Vulkan 问题（RDNA AWQ 慢 2.5×、gfx1151 NaN、VRAM 误报）。集群标准化应将 ROCm 视为一个独立的、重度依赖版本锁定的环境——而非 CUDA 路径的直接替代。

4. 消费级 Blackwell（SM120/GB10）在两个服务引擎上开箱即属损坏层级。 vLLM（CUDA 图失败、静默空补全）与 SGLang（CUDA 13 wheel 安装失败；因移除 DSV4.1 DeepGEMM 门控导致约 8× prefill 回归，#49173）独立证实 SM120 当前对量化 MoE 或长上下文尚未生产就绪。Blackwell 数据中心（SM100/SM90）没问题；消费级 SKU 才是缺口。

5. 网关正成为受审计的控制平面。 LiteLLM 的五个已关闭高危预算/限流绕过（预留路径之外的项目预算、陈旧重置将支出清零、已删除团队密钥的认证缓存残留、按团队模型限制减半）加上预先宣布的 2.0.0 空 models 语义变更，意味着 agent/应用开发者应：升级后审计限额，在链式代理拓扑中对照提供商账单核对流式用量（#36114），并在弃用窗口关闭前显式枚举允许的模型。

6. OpenAI 兼容是入场券，结构化输出才是创新。 llama.cpp 的顶层 json_schema 修复（b12229）、Ollama 的 /v1/models 空数组变更与截断转发，以及 Unsloth Studio 的自定义端点网关，都汇聚于 OpenAI 线格式兼容。下一步是模式强制的结构化生成——llama.cpp 的 token 感知聊天解析（#29307/#31978）正将 <think>/工具调用解析从客户端字符串匹配迁移到服务端发出的字段。为 agent 框架规划这一迁移。

7. 下周关注：

  • vLLM： Marlin→Humming 迁移是否能以同等性能落地；DeepSeek-V4.1 的 SM120 CUDA 图修复。
  • SGLang： v0.5.22→v0.5.23 解码回归的解决（对 DeepSeek-V4.1 交互式 agent 至关重要）；MI450 all-reduce 落地。
  • llama.cpp： KV 缓存截断（#11970）与 prompt 缓存恢复（#30961）——两者均为长期 HIGH 且影响多轮正确性。
  • Ollama： 在 v0.40.16-rc0 与 #19632 VRAM 核算修复之后趋于稳定——这是本周期升级的最强理由。
  • LiteLLM： 2.0.0 迁移工具；面向 Anthropic 协议客户端的原生 /v1/messages 栈完成。
  • Unsloth： 带确定性验证的解码图 GA；可增长 KV 发布；Studio 是成熟为可信的 agent 路由网关，还是仍停留在开发工具。

本报告基于 2026-11-10 六个项目的摘要快照生成。所有 issue/PR 编号引用上文各项目摘要。

6. 对应用开发者的意义

  • 有意识地固定版本。 如果你在 Hopper 上使用推测解码服务 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，在采用 v0.5.23 前先做基准测试——报告的 33–45% decode 减速对交互式 agent 而言影响重大。
  • SM120 消费级 Blackwell 尚不是开箱即用的目标。 RTX 50 系列和 GB10 部署应预期需要固定旧镜像、强制 Triton attention，并避免依赖 DeepGEMM indexer 路径（见 #49209、#49173、#42012）。
  • EAGLE repetition penalty 修复值得关注，如果你在使用推测解码时设置 repetition_penalty != 1——PR #49404 修正了 verify 中已知的质量偏差。
  • PD 分离和超节点 KV 缓存共享（#43699、#43098）是最影响多租户 agent 路由成本的路线图项；缓存感知多模态路由（#48937）是你服务图像聊天时的第一个实用组件。

  • 如果你维护树外模型， 请关注 #48475——当前四个私有触点（registry、attention 查找、attention kernel、logprob sampler）在正式化之前是维护隐患。

4. 性能与优化

  • 后端上传剪枝（#31419，b12224）：ggml-backend 不再上传内容从未被读取的张量——对多后端图直接节省带宽/H2D 开销。
  • Adreno Vulkan 标量 FA 上限（#30829）：对 head size >128 且 KV ≥1024 的情况将行数上限设为 8，防止寄存器溢出（在 X1-85 上观察到每次调用 264 B）。与移动端/Qualcomm 部署相关。
  • OpenCL int8 融合 KQ（#30249）：按 head-size 切片暂存 Q，启用 head size 512，并在分解式 prefill attention 中减少随 head size 增长的本地内存。
  • ARM NEON 非 dotprod IQ4_NL_Q8 GEMM/GEMV 4×4 重打包（#30165）：将快速路径扩展到 ARMv8 < 8.2-A（无 vdotq_laneq_s32）。
  • x86 BF16 点积（#31878）：在不支持 AVX512-BF16 的 x86 上保持 F32 激活，避免重复转换和精度损失（#31842）。
  • MMVQ 截断表（#28090）：提议为 Q4_0 添加 sm_86 条目（在 A10 上约 9.1%）；仍开放。
  • Battlemage 上的 SYCL：反复出现“极其糟糕”性能的报告（#22413，现已关闭）——除非提交新 issue，否则预计不会有即时修复。

5. 稳定性与回归

按严重程度排序：

  1. 高 — /v1/chat/completions 上 KV 缓存被错误截断（#11970，50 条评论，仍开放）。长期存在；影响多轮对话的正确性。未引用修复 PR。
  2. 高 — 统一 KV 缓存下提示缓存恢复失败（#30961）。槽位空闲清除顺序 bug；影响服务器恢复延迟。
  3. 高 — 含 NaN 的循环状态未被清除（#29830）。NaN 传播会在循环架构上扰乱后续请求。
  4. 高 — 投机解码破坏 temp‑0 一致性（#31472）。draft-dflash / draft-dspark 即使在 100% 接受率下也偏离自回归输出——与对可复现性敏感的评估管道直接相关。与后端无关。
  5. 中 — ggml_backend_sched_alloc_splits 意外重分配崩溃（#28753），出现在 Intel Arc / IntelLLVM 构建上。
  6. 中 — SYCL+MoE 上 logprobs 非确定性（#31206）；请求 seed 无法固定分布。
  7. 中 — Metal 长上下文下 1 个 token 后解码 EOS（Qwen3.8-Flash-Next）（#28805，因过期关闭）——阈值随量化/KV 量化/n_ctx 变化。
  8. 中 — Windows AMD VRAM 误报导致共享内存溢出（#30250）。
  9. 低 — Vulkan Adreno 管道创建失败（mul_mat_vec_q4_k_f32_f32，shaderc/NDK SPIR-V 不匹配）（#28635）。
  10. 低 — ggml_gallocr 在节点身份变化时复用过期计划（#28448，因过期关闭）——存在静默稀疏 MoE 损坏风险。

今日/本周期已修复： Metal FA 越界写入（#31662，b12221）；Metal TRI ±inf→NaN（#30711，b12220）；Qwen4exp 合并张量断言（#31189，已关闭）；json_schema response_format（#10732，已关闭）。

6. 这对应用开发者意味着什么

  • OpenAI 兼容性正在收紧。 response_format 中的顶层 json_schema 现在可用（b12229）——你可以去掉包装 hack。但 KV 缓存截断（#11970）和提示缓存恢复失败（#30961）仍然开放，因此对长多轮会话要保守，并考虑在服务器端使用固定/扩展上下文。
  • 投机解码的可复现性注意事项。 如果你在 --temp 0 下运行评估或确定性 agent，在 #31472 解决之前，避免在 qwen35moe 目标上使用 draft-dflash/draft-dspark——输出与 AR 解码并非 token 级一致。
  • SYCL+MoE 上的非确定性 logprobs（#31206）意味着在 Intel iGPU + MoE 配置上，不要依赖 /v1/completions 的 logprobs 进行评分/重排序。
  • 多模态音频正在获得一等公民地位。 mtmd_helper_resampler（b12236）+ Gemma 4 流式（余弦 ≥0.993 对比非流式）使 /v1/audio/* 和实时端点对生产语音 agent 变得可行——预计 #31763 会带来更多 /v1/audio/speech 工作。
  • token 感知的聊天解析即将到来（#29307、#31978）。如果你从原始输出中自行解析 <think>/工具调用 token，请计划在它落地后迁移到服务器发出的结构化字段——这将比字符串匹配更健壮。
  • 新的草稿模型架构（DSpine、DFLASH2、Kimi K3.1 视觉）持续扩展投机解码和多模态面；请针对你的目标量化和后端进行验证——目前有几个仅在 Metal/CUDA 上测试过。
  • Windows AMD 用户：VRAM 误报（#30250）可能悄悄推入共享内存并拖垮吞吐量；请监控你实际的 VRAM 余量，而不是信任运行时报告的内存预算。
Ollama — ollama/ollama

Ollama 摘要 — 2026-11-10

1. 今日亮点

候选版本 v0.40.16-rc0 发布，包含 OpenAI 兼容性工作：在 /v1/responses 请求中转发截断选项，以及当未安装任何模型时 /v1/models 返回空数组（而非错误）。进行中最重要的修复是 PR #19632，这是一个多问题的“VRAM 核算与 GPU 拆分”修正，针对模型驱逐、加载失败和不必要的多 GPU 分散问题。与此同时，浮现出若干内存/调度器回归：Windows 上间歇性 CUDA 初始化回退、ROCm/ollama ps VRAM 报告差异，以及 Vulkan/RADV 在首次请求后约 30 倍的生成速度下降。

2. 发布与破坏性变更

  • v0.40.16-rc0 (v0.40.16) — https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19501
    • openai：在 responses 请求中转发截断选项（PR #19501）。
    • openai：当未安装任何模型时，/v1/models 返回空数组（PR #19539）——假设空模型列表会在加载时失败的客户端应验证其对 200 + [] 的处理。

  • Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.5-MoE 并行请求：PR #17144 提议解除 server/sched.go 中硬编码的 numParallel = 1 黑名单，因为上游 llama.cpp 混合架构崩溃已修复（2026-03-08）—— https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/17144。

  • VRAM 核算与 GPU 拆分（进行中）：PR #19632（issue #19631）修复错误的 VRAM 预测、GPU 开销预留以及不必要的模型拆分，后者导致了错误的驱逐和加载拒绝—— https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19632
  • Vulkan 提示缓存回归：Issue #19201（已关闭）记录了在启用捆绑的 llama.cpp 主机内存提示缓存时，第二次相同请求出现可复现的约 29.7 倍生成吞吐量崩塌，AMD RX 6600 XT / Mesa RADV，Ollama 0.40.8—— https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/19201
  • num_predict == -2 动态 token 限制（填充上下文缓冲区）PR #9547 已关闭—— https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/9547

5. 稳定性与回归

按严重程度排序：

  1. CUDA 预热失败 + 静默 CPU 回退 — Issue #17380（开放）：Windows/RTX 5070 Ti 上使用 gpt-oss:20b 时间歇性出现 CUDA error: shared object initialization failed，与静默的 CUDA_Host → CPU 固定缓冲区回退相关；未引用修复 PR—— https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/17380

6. 对应用开发者的意义

  • OpenAI 兼容客户端：/v1/models 空数组变更是在客户端代码中需要测试的一项行为——将零安装模型视为有效状态，而非错误。/v1/responses 中的截断转发提升了与 OpenAI 语义的对等性。
  • 结构化工具调用：如果你使用 Codex/DeepSeek 风格的压缩循环，请固定版本并关注 #19623——孤立的函数输出可能破坏代理状态机。使用非 ASCII 参数的 Olmo3 用户应跟踪 #18906。

  • Qwen3.5 并行性：一旦 #17144 落地，MoE 服务吞吐量增益将可用；在此之前，这些架构预期 numParallel=1。

6. 这对应用开发者意味着什么

  • 如果你使用按团队按模型上限，请审计你的限流。 减半 bug（#34140）意味着有效吞吐量可能只有配置的一半；升级后重新检查，并在依赖 model_per_team 实现 SLA 式隔离前进行负载测试。

  • 现在为 2.0.0 空 models 语义变更做规划： 在密钥和团队上显式枚举允许的模型，并关注新的启动警告（#50720）以发现遗留配置。

Unsloth — unslothai/unsloth

Unsloth 摘要 — 2026-11-10

1. 今日亮点

过去 24 小时没有新版本发布，但 main 分支上堆叠了大量推理引擎相关的工作：Daniel Han 提交了一系列 decode CUDA graph PR（#16587 为基础，外加针对 Gemma 4 和 Qwen3.5/3.6 的模型专属扩展），声称在 T4 上实现 2–8 倍 decode 加速，且输出 token 完全一致。与此同时，Studio 的模型服务层（面向前端本地模型的 HTTP 网关）积累了几个与 OpenAI 兼容端点相关的 issue——尤其是自定义/vLLM/Ollama 连接下视频被静默拒绝的问题，但修复 PR 已开放（#17322）。

2. 版本发布与破坏性变更

无新版本发布。有一个依赖锁定隐患值得注意：typer 0.29.0（发布于 2026-11-09 18:48 UTC）会导致 Windows 上的 Studio 安装失败，原因是它持有 pydantic_core 不放。将 typer 限制在 <0.29 的修复已合并（#17319）。如果你基于 Studio 安装器构建，在 Windows 上请避免使用未锁定版本的 typer。

3. 新模型与硬件支持

  • Gemma 4、Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.6（qwen3_5、qwen3_5_moe） — CUDA graph 下的 flex-attention decode 步骤（#17329）。
  • Qwen3.5/3.6 混合线性注意力（Gated DeltaNet） — 为 LinearAttentionLayer 静态缓存提供 decode graph 支持，此前该场景被直接拒绝（#17324）。
  • 基础 decode-graph PR 中的文本模型广泛覆盖：Gemma 3/4、Muse-Glimmer、Qwen3 / Qwen3-VL text、Llama、Mistral 3、Granite、Phi-4、OLMo 2、Cohere 2、GLM-4（#16587）。
  • Linux GPU 检测回归 — issue 报告支持 CUDA 的 Linux 主机被强制使用 CPU（#17235，已关闭）。另有报告称 Windows 图像生成在 RTX 3060 上回退到内存（#16803，已关闭）。

4. 性能与优化

  • 所有 FastModel model.generate() 默认启用 decode CUDA graph — 重放捕获的单 token 步骤，而非承担内核启动开销；在 T4 上实测2–8 倍提升，输出 token 完全一致（#16587）。
  • 可选启用的可增长 KV 缓存（UNSLOTH_GROWABLE_KV=1）— 避免 StaticCache 为每个全注意力层预分配 prompt + max_new_tokens。默认关闭；未设置时行为零变化（#17296）。
  • Studio / WebKit 长对话性能系列 — 多个 PR 针对菜单/对话框/浏览器面板打开成本随对话长度增长的问题：通过消除每帧线程工作和重新布局，150 轮基准从约 460–560 ms 降至短对话水平（#17282、#17284、#17323）。
  • MCP 工具循环低效 — 启用大量 MCP 工具时，GGUF 对话几乎每条消息都重新处理整个 prompt；开放中的 PR 保留延迟工具定义（#17326，追踪自 #17015）。

5. 稳定性与回归

按服务型工作负载的严重程度排序：

  1. 自定义 OpenAI 兼容连接（vLLM/OMLX/llama.cpp/Ollama）下视频上传被拒绝，即使后端支持视频（#17295）。修复 PR 已开放：#17322。
  2. Linux 被强制从 GPU 降级到 CPU — 已关闭，但对受影响者而言是硬性降级（#17235）。
  3. Studio 网页抓取的 HTML→Markdown 转换器 bug — 裸 & 后残留 ;、代码围栏内逃逸内容泄漏、畸形实体导致后续页面内容按原始 HTML 渲染（#17199）。如果你依赖抓取工具的输出质量或将其送入下游解析，此问题值得关注。
  4. 托管账户文件夹浏览 403 — 安装为符号链接时 /api/models/browse-folders 返回 403；影响多租户 Studio 部署（#17292，修复 PR #17321）。
  5. typer 0.29 导致 Windows 安装失败 — 修复已合并（#17319）。
  6. 附件注释解析器误报 — 文件内容形似沙箱附件注释时被解析为第二个附件（#16913，已关闭）。
  7. TRL 1.15 下 CPU SFTTrainer 评估损失错误 — 除以未移位的标签数量，导致首个 token 未被掩码时 eval_loss 被低估（#17291）。修复了纯 CPU 微调流程的损失曲线失真问题。
  8. ROCM TunableOp 测试回归 — 自 #17299 起 main 上出现回归，修复 PR 已开放（#17325）。

6. 对应用开发者的意义

  • Decode 吞吐量即将免费获得实质性提升。 如果你通过 FastModel.generate() 服务 Qwen3.x/Llama/Gemma 级模型，默认启用的 decode graph 应在较旧 GPU（T4 级）上带来多倍 token 速率提升，且输出不变。下个版本发布后值得基准测试你的 p50/p99 延迟；同时，请验证对确定性敏感的评估仍然一致。
  • 可增长 KV 缓存的可选启用值得长上下文服务关注。 固定 StaticCache 的过度分配一直是并发长 prompt 工作负载的真实瓶颈；如果你运行高 max_new_tokens 但实际生成量不大，发布后可试用 UNSLOTH_GROWABLE_KV=1。
  • 目前还不要信任"自定义 OpenAI 兼容"的多模态能力 — 视频在客户端就被拒绝，根本到不了 vLLM/Ollama。在修复落地前，请锁定到修复 PR 或在本地模型加载上验证。
  • Studio 正在积累一个真正的 OpenAI 兼容网关表面（自定义端点、MCP 工具、网页抓取、托管账户）。该层的 bug 密度——权限模式仅限会话（#17297）、偏好同步缺口（#16912）、MCP prompt 重复处理——表明它目前仍在成熟过程中，尚未达到可用于生产级 agent 路由的加固程度。
  • 如果你在桌面上做图像 LoRA 或大规模语料索引，资源管理仍需手动：项目索引没有暂停/限流机制，可能饿死推理（#16992，已关闭），图像 LoRA 训练也缺少可复用的设置配置（#16979，已关闭）。

本日报由 agents-radar 自动生成。
